347	TAB_PROBE_S = 8          # a page that cannot evaluate `1` within this long is hung
348	
349	
350	async def close_hung_tabs(browser: int, keep: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
351	    """Close the tabs of `browser` whose page no longer runs JavaScript. browser-use attaches to every tab when it
352	    connects; one hung tab made each connect time out after 15 s, although the browser itself still answered (two
353	    sandbox runs: the submitter failed 5 times that way). `keep` is never closed. Returns the closed target ids."""
354	    async def probe(client) -> list[str]:
355	        targets = (await client.send.Target.getTargets())["targetInfos"]
356	        pages = [t for t in targets if t.get("type") == "page" and t["targetId"] != keep]
357	
358	        async def hung(target) -> bool:
359	            try:
360	                async with asyncio.timeout(TAB_PROBE_S):
361	                    attached = await client.send.Target.attachToTarget(
362	                        params={"targetId": target["targetId"], "flatten": True})
363	                    await client.send.Runtime.evaluate(params={"expression": "1"}, session_id=attached["sessionId"])
364	                    await client.send.Target.detachFromTarget(params={"sessionId": attached["sessionId"]})
365	                return False
366	            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - timeout or a target that vanished: only a timeout counts as hung
367	                return True
368	
369	        verdicts = await asyncio.gather(*(hung(t) for t in pages))
370	        closed: list[str] = []
371	        for target, is_hung in zip(pages, verdicts):
372	            if is_hung:
373	                try:
374	                    await asyncio.wait_for(client.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": target["targetId"]}), 5)
375	                    _OWNERS.pop(target["targetId"], None)
376	                    closed.append(target["targetId"])
377	                    log.warning("browser %d: closed a hung tab (%s)", browser, str(target.get("url"))[:80])
378	                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
379	                    continue
380	        return closed
381	
382	    if not browsers.cdp_urls():
383	        return []
384	    try:
385	        return await asyncio.wait_for(_with_cdp(browser, probe), TAB_PROBE_S + 15)
386	    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
387	        log.debug("hung-tab check on browser %d failed: %s", browser, error)
388	        return []

391	async def responsive_tab(tab: "Tab") -> "Tab":
392	    """The tab to work in: `tab` if its browser answers, else a new tab of the next browser that does. Any browser can
393	    open any site, so one dead browser must not take a whole role (or the signing) down with it."""
394	    urls = browsers.cdp_urls()
395	    if not urls:
396	        return tab
397	    if await browser_responds(tab.browser):
398	        closed = await close_hung_tabs(tab.browser)
399	        if tab.target_id and tab.target_id in closed:
400	            log.warning("browser %d: this agent's tab was hung and closed; continuing in a new tab", tab.browser)
401	            return Tab(tab.browser)
402	        return tab
403	    for step in range(1, len(urls)):
404	        other = (tab.browser + step) % len(urls)
405	        if await browser_responds(other):
406	            log.warning("browser %d is unreachable: continuing in a new tab of browser %d", tab.browser, other)
407	            return Tab(other)
408	    return tab   # none answers: try the original again (the caller's retry logic takes over)

418	def owner_of(target_id: str) -> Tab | None:
419	    """The tab a target belongs to: its own claim, else the owner of the tab that opened it (popup of a popup too)."""
420	    seen = set()
421	    while target_id and target_id not in seen:
422	        seen.add(target_id)
423	        if target_id in _OWNERS:
424	            return _OWNERS[target_id]
425	        target_id = _OPENERS.get(target_id, "")
426	    return None

432	def _visible_page_targets(self) -> list:
433	    """What a session sees as "the browser's tabs": its own tab first, then popups its pages opened; never another
434	    agent's tab or popups. A tab nobody owns and no owned tab opened (the browser's first tab) is visible only to the
435	    browser's main tab, which claims it. browser-use derives its tab list, focus and new-tab reuse from this."""

463	async def _enable_page_monitoring_routed(self, cdp_session) -> None:
464	    """browser-use registers one lifecycle handler per page target, but the CDP client keeps only ONE handler per event
465	    (the last one), and that handler drops events of every other target. With several tabs in a browser, navigations
466	    in all but the last-attached tab then waited for load events that never came (3-8 s per navigation). Here one
467	    handler per client routes each event to the queue of its own target."""
468	    await _enable_page_monitoring(self, cdp_session)
469	    events = getattr(cdp_session, "_lifecycle_events", None)
470	    if events is None:
471	        return
472	    routes = self.__dict__.setdefault("_lifecycle_routes", {})
473	    routes[cdp_session.target_id] = events
474	
475	    def route(event, session_id=None):
476	        target = self.get_target_id_from_session_id(session_id) if session_id else None
477	        queue = routes.get(target)
478	        if queue is not None:
479	            queue.append({"name": event.get("name", "unknown"), "loaderId": event.get("loaderId", "none"),
480	                          "timestamp": asyncio.get_event_loop().time()})
481	
482	    cdp_session.cdp_client.register.Page.lifecycleEvent(route)

488	class RobustSession(BrowserSession):
489	    """A BrowserSession whose navigation recovers from a tab stuck while loading: stop the old load and retry once.
490	    It works in its own `Tab` (set `_tab` before starting), with focus emulation on: with several windows only one has
491	    the OS focus, and in the others typed text and focus-dependent page scripts did nothing (logins "did not register",
492	    links "did not navigate"). Playwright enables the same emulation on every page for this reason."""
493	
494	    _tab: Any = PrivateAttr(default=None)
495	    _focus_emulated: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
496	    _dialogs_handled: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
497	    _state_timeouts: int = PrivateAttr(default=0)
498	    _dialog_tasks: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
499	    _dialog_pending: dict = PrivateAttr(default_factory=dict)
500	
501	    async def get_browser_state_summary(self, include_screenshot: bool = True, cached: bool = False,
502	                                        include_recent_events: bool = False):
503	        try:
504	            async with asyncio.timeout(30):
505	                state = await super().get_browser_state_summary(
506	                    include_screenshot=include_screenshot, cached=cached, include_recent_events=include_recent_events)
507	            self._state_timeouts = 0
508	            return state
509	        except TimeoutError as error:
510	            self._state_timeouts += 1
511	            raise RuntimeError('Browser state capture timed out after 30s; retry observation before acting') from error
512	
513	    async def connect(self, cdp_url: str | None = None):
514	        await super().connect(cdp_url)
515	        tab, focus = self._tab, self.agent_focus_target_id
516	        if tab is not None and focus and tab.target_id != focus:
517	            alive = {t.target_id for t in _all_page_targets(self.session_manager)}
518	            if tab.target_id not in alive:      # a main tab's first use, or the agent closed its tab: adopt this one
519	                _OWNERS.pop(tab.target_id or "", None)
520	                tab.popups.discard(focus)
521	                tab.claim(focus)
522	        if tab is not None and focus:
523	            await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(focus, focus=True)     # turns focus emulation on for the tab
524	        return self
525	
526	    async def get_or_create_cdp_session(self, target_id=None, focus: bool = True):
527	        session = await super().get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=focus)
528	        if focus and self._tab is not None:
529	            self._tab.adopt(session.target_id)      # the agent went into a popup of its tab: keep others out
530	        if focus and self._tab is not None and session.session_id not in self._focus_emulated:
531	            self._focus_emulated.add(session.session_id)
532	            try:
533	                await session.cdp_client.send.Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled(
534	                    params={"enabled": True}, session_id=session.session_id)
535	            except Exception as error:
536	                log.debug("focus emulation failed: %s", error)
537	        if focus and session.session_id not in self._dialogs_handled:
538	            self._dialogs_handled.add(session.session_id)
539	            await self._handle_dialogs(session)
540	        return session
541	
542	    async def _handle_dialogs(self, session) -> None:
543	        """Accept native JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm such as "submit binding bid?", beforeunload) in the agent's
544	        tab. browser-use registers this per new tab, but its handler missed the bid wizard's final confirm: the page
545	        then froze, every page script and state read waited for the dialog, and the run ended without an answer."""
546	        root = self._cdp_client_root or session.cdp_client
547	
548	        async def dismiss(event, session_id=None):
549	            kind, message = event.get("type", "alert"), event.get("message", "")
550	            try:
551	                self._closed_popup_messages.append(f"[{kind}] {message}")
552	            except Exception:
553	                pass
554	            log.info("accepting %s dialog: %s", kind, message[:120])
555	            try:
556	                await asyncio.wait_for(root.send.Page.handleJavaScriptDialog(
557	                    params={"accept": kind != "prompt"}, session_id=session_id or session.session_id), 5)
558	                return True
559	            except Exception as error:
560	                log.debug("dialog handling failed: %s", error)
561	                return False
562	
563	        def target_for(session_id):
564	            manager = self.session_manager
565	            return (manager.get_target_id_from_session_id(session_id) if manager and session_id else None) or getattr(session, "target_id", session_id)
566	
567	        def on_closed(event, session_id=None):
568	            target = target_for(session_id or session.session_id)
569	            for key in list(self._dialog_pending):
570	                if key[0] == target:
571	                    self._dialog_pending.pop(key, None)
572	
573	        def on_dialog(event, session_id=None):
574	            # cdp-use awaits async callbacks inside its sole WebSocket receive loop. Waiting for a CDP
575	            # response there prevents that very response from being received and stalls page observation.
576	            key = (target_for(session_id or session.session_id), event.get("type"), event.get("message"))
577	            if key in self._dialog_pending:
578	                return
579	            task = asyncio.create_task(dismiss(event, session_id))
580	            self._dialog_pending[key] = task
581	            self._dialog_tasks.add(task)
582	            def finished(done):
583	                self._dialog_tasks.discard(done)
584	                if done.cancelled() or done.exception() or not done.result():
585	                    if self._dialog_pending.get(key) is done:
586	                        self._dialog_pending.pop(key, None)
587	            task.add_done_callback(finished)
588	        try:
589	            session.cdp_client.register.Page.javascriptDialogOpening(on_dialog)
590	            session.cdp_client.register.Page.javascriptDialogClosed(on_closed)
591	            await session.cdp_client.send.Page.enable(session_id=session.session_id)
592	        except Exception as error:
593	            log.debug("dialog handler not registered: %s", error)
594	
595	    async def _navigate_and_wait(self, url, target_id, timeout=None, wait_until="load"):
596	        try:
597	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)
598	        except RuntimeError as error:
599	            if "timed out" not in str(error):
600	                raise
601	            log.warning("navigation stuck, stopping the old load and retrying: %s", url)
602	            session = await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=False)
603	            try:
604	                await asyncio.wait_for(session.cdp_client.send.Page.stopLoading(session_id=session.session_id), 5)
605	            except Exception as stop_error:
606	                log.debug("stopLoading failed: %s", stop_error)
607	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)
608

725	async def browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, tab: Tab | None = None, site_id: str = "", on_record=None,
726	                 max_steps: int = 40, hints: str = "", author: str = "browse", use_vision=False,
727	                 stop_reserve: float | None = None, extra_tools=None, max_actions_per_step: int = 4,
728	                 flash: bool = True, careful: bool = False, dedupe_reads: bool = True,
729	                 stop_on_record: str = "") -> dict:
730	    """Run a browser-use agent until done / max_steps / out of time. Returns {"summary", "records", "steps", "done"}.
731	
732	    `tab`: the tab to work in (default: the main tab of `browser`). Screenshots are off by default
733	    (`use_vision=False`): capturing them hung in the sandbox browsers, and `read_page` already reads canvas labels and
734	    hidden text. `flash`: short replies + compact prompt (see module doc). `stop_reserve`: stop when the run has this
735	    many seconds left (default: the SUBMIT reserve). `extra_tools(tools)` may register more actions. Pages read with a
736	    `topic` reach `on_record` as {"kind": "page", "data": {...}}.
737	    A PopupGuard (swarm/guard.py) clears popups, notices and error pages next to the agent; `careful=True` limits it to
738	    noise without inputs (the bid submitter). `dedupe_reads`: read_page of a URL another agent already saved returns
739	    the saved text instead of opening it again (off for mails that change, such as TANs).
740	    """
741	    records: list[dict] = []
742	    reserve = SUBMIT_RESERVE_S if stop_reserve is None else stop_reserve
743	
744	    async def emit(rec: dict) -> None:
745	        records.append(rec)
746	        if on_record:
747	            await on_record(rec)
748	
749	    tools = build_tools(ctx, site_id, author, emit, dedupe_reads=dedupe_reads, stop_on_record=stop_on_record)
750	    if extra_tools:
751	        extra_tools(tools)
752	
753	    tab = await responsive_tab(tab or main_tab(browser))
754	    await tab.open()
755	    session = make_session(ctx, tab, vision=bool(use_vision))
756	    prompt = dict(flash_mode=True, override_system_message=FLASH_SYSTEM.format(max_actions=max_actions_per_step)) \
757	        if flash else {}
758	    tips = site_tips(ctx, site_id)
759	    hints = hints + ("\nTips from other agents on this site:\n- " + "\n- ".join(tips) if tips else "")
760	    # A tab an agent already worked in is on the site (logged in, past gates): start from its current page instead of
761	    # browser-use opening the site's start URL from the goal again.
762	    reused = tab.used and bool(browsers.cdp_urls())
763	    tab.used = True
764	    browsing_llm = make_llm(flash)
765	    browsing_llm._usage_ctx = ctx
766	    agent = Agent(task=goal + ("\n\nThis tab is already on the site: start from the current page." if reused else ""),
767	                  llm=browsing_llm, browser_session=session, tools=tools, use_vision=use_vision,
768	                  use_judge=False, generate_gif=False, max_failures=6, max_actions_per_step=max_actions_per_step,
769	                  llm_timeout=CALL_TIMEOUT_S + 2, step_timeout=120, directly_open_url=not reused,
770	                  extend_system_message=SYSTEM_EXTRA + (f"\n{hints}" if hints else ""), **prompt)
771	    guard = PopupGuard(ctx, author, careful=careful,
772	                       fill=lambda pairs, then_click, item_id: fill_page(session, pairs, "", then_click, item_id))
773	    evaluate = lambda js, *a: _evaluate(session, js, *a)  # noqa: E731
774	    guard_task: asyncio.Task | None = None
775	
776	    async def before_step(_agent) -> None:
777	        nonlocal guard_task
778	        if ctx.seconds_left() <= reserve:
779	            agent.stop()
780	            return
781	        try:                    # the page the model is about to see: cleared first
782	            await asyncio.wait_for(guard.sweep(evaluate), 25)
783	        except Exception as error:
784	            log.debug("guard before step failed: %s", error)
785	        if guard_task is None:  # from now on also between steps (popups that appear while the model thinks)
786	            guard_task = asyncio.create_task(guard.loop(evaluate))
787	
788	    secrets = [str((s.get("credentials") or {}).get("password") or "") for s in (ctx.task.get("access") or [])] \
789	        if ctx is not None else []
790	
791	    async def after_step(_agent) -> None:
792	        try:
793	            line = _step_line(agent)
794	            for secret in secrets:        # the model's memory sometimes repeats the login
795	                if len(secret) >= 4:
796	                    line = line.replace(secret, "***")
797	            log.info("%s step %d: %s", author, agent.state.n_steps - 1, line)
798	        except Exception as error:
799	            log.debug("step line failed: %s", error)
800	        if session._state_timeouts >= 2:
801	            log.warning("%s: repeated browser-state timeouts; ending this connection so the caller can reattach", author)
802	            agent.stop()
803	
804	    try:
805	        async with asyncio.timeout(max(1, ctx.seconds_left() - reserve)):
806	            history = await agent.run(max_steps=max_steps, on_step_start=before_step, on_step_end=after_step)
807	    except TimeoutError:
808	        history = agent.history
809	    finally:
810	        if guard_task is not None:
811	            guard_task.cancel()
812	            await asyncio.gather(guard_task, return_exceptions=True)
813	        try:
814	            async with asyncio.timeout(8):
815	                await session.kill() if not browsers.cdp_urls() else await session.stop()
816	        except TimeoutError:
817	            log.warning("browser cleanup exceeded its budget for %s", author)
818	        finally:
819	            tasks = list(session._dialog_tasks)
820	            for task in tasks:
821	                task.cancel()
822	            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
823	            if browsing_llm._sdk_client is not None:
824	                await browsing_llm._sdk_client.close()
825	    summary = history.final_result() or ("Browser state repeatedly timed out; reattach to the existing tab and inspect it"
826	                                         if session._state_timeouts >= 2 else "")
827	    return {"summary": summary, "records": records, "steps": len(history.history),
828	            "done": history.is_done() and history.is_successful() is True,
829	            "finished": history.is_done(), "guard_actions": guard.actions}

21	def is_set_unit(unit) -> bool:
22	    u = str(unit or "").strip().lower()

26	def valid_condition(conditions: list[dict], material: str, scenario) -> dict | None:
27	    """The material's price condition valid on the scenario date (both endpoints inclusive); latest start wins."""
28	    if scenario is None:
29	        return None
30	    valid = []
31	    for c in conditions:
32	        if norm_ref(c.get("material")) != norm_ref(material):
33	            continue
34	        start, end = to_datetime(c.get("valid_from")), validity_end(c.get("valid_to"))
35	        if (c.get("valid_from") and start is None) or (c.get("valid_to") and end is None):
36	            continue
37	        if (start is None or start <= scenario) and (end is None or scenario <= end):
38	            valid.append((start or to_datetime("1970-01-01"), c))
39	    return max(valid, key=lambda x: x[0])[1] if valid else None

42	def scale_price(condition: dict, pieces: int) -> Decimal | None:
43	    """Per-piece price at the highest scale whose minimum quantity <= pieces, divided by the price unit."""
44	    fmt = condition.get("number_format")
45	    rows = []
46	    for s in condition.get("scales") or []:
47	        q, p = to_decimal(s.get("min_qty"), fmt), to_decimal(s.get("price"), fmt)
48	        if q is not None and p is not None and 0 <= q <= pieces and p >= 0:
49	            rows.append((q, p))
50	    if not rows:
51	        return None
52	    unit = to_decimal(condition.get("price_unit"))
53	    return max(rows)[1] / unit if unit is not None and unit > 0 else None

56	def allocate_cents(total: Decimal, weights: dict[str, Decimal]) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
57	    """Split `total` (EUR) proportionally in cents: floor, then remaining cents to the largest remainders,
58	    ties by ascending position identifier."""
59	    cents = int((total * 100).to_integral_value())
60	    wsum = sum(weights.values(), D0)
61	    if wsum <= 0 or not weights:
62	        return {k: D0 for k in weights}
63	    exact = {k: Decimal(cents) * w / wsum for k, w in weights.items()}
64	    floors = {k: int(v.to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)) for k, v in exact.items()}
65	    rest = cents - sum(floors.values())
66	    order = sorted(weights, key=lambda k: (-(exact[k] - floors[k]), k))
67	    for k in order[:rest]:
68	        floors[k] += 1
69	    return {k: Decimal(v) / 100 for k, v in floors.items()}

72	def marginal_bonus(base_total: Decimal, bands: list[dict]) -> Decimal:
73	    credit = D0
74	    for b in bands:
75	        lo = to_decimal(b.get("from")) or D0
76	        hi = to_decimal(b.get("to")) if b.get("to") not in (None, "", "null") else None
77	        pct = to_decimal(b.get("percent")) or D0
78	        top = base_total if hi is None else min(base_total, hi)
79	        if top > lo:
80	            credit += (top - lo) * pct / 100
81	    return round_cents(credit)

84	def position_keys(clarifications: list[dict], position: str) -> dict:
85	    """Commercial keys and setup fee the latest Q&A answers assign to a position (withdrawn answers ignored)."""
86	    withdrawn = withdrawn_numbers(clarifications)
87	    keys, fee = {}, None
88	    ordered = sorted(clarifications, key=lambda c: to_datetime(c.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
89	    for c in ordered:
90	        if norm_ref(c.get("number")) in withdrawn or position not in [str(x).strip() for x in c.get("positions") or []]:
91	            continue
92	        for k, v in (c.get("keys") or {}).items():
93	            if v not in (None, "", "null"):
94	                keys[k] = v
95	        if c.get("setup_fee") not in (None, "", "null"):
96	            fee = to_decimal(c["setup_fee"], "de-DE" if "," in str(c["setup_fee"]) else None)
97	    return {"keys": keys, "setup_fee": fee}

100	def compute(inputs: dict) -> dict:
101	    brief, tender = inputs.get("brief") or {}, inputs.get("tender") or {}
102	    quantities, requirements = inputs.get("quantities") or {}, inputs.get("requirements") or {}
103	    matched, erp = inputs.get("materials") or {}, inputs.get("erp") or {}
104	    discount, mail = inputs.get("discount") or {}, inputs.get("mail") or {}
105	    scenario = to_datetime(brief.get("scenario_date"))
106	    erp_materials = {norm_ref(k): v for k, v in (erp.get("materials") or {}).items()}
107	    issues, omitted, lines = [], [], {}
108	    clarifications = tender.get("clarifications") or []
109	
110	    # 1. per position: pieces, material, EUR base price
111	    for p in tender.get("positions") or []:
112	        pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
113	        q = (quantities.get(pos) or {}).get("quantity")
114	        req = next((v for k, v in requirements.items() if norm_ref(k) == norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref"))), {}) or {}
115	        mat = (matched.get(pos) or {}).get("material")
116	        line = {"position": pos, "material": mat, "unit": p.get("unit"), "required": (matched.get(pos) or {}).get("required"),
117	                "short_text": p.get("short_text"), **position_keys(clarifications, pos)}
118	        lines[pos] = line
119	        if q is None:
120	            issues.append(f"{pos}: no quantity")
121	            continue
122	        if is_set_unit(p.get("unit")):
123	            per_set = to_decimal(req.get("pieces_per_set"))
124	            if not per_set:
125	                issues.append(f"{pos}: quantity in sets but pieces per set unknown")
126	                continue
127	            q = (to_decimal(q) * per_set) if to_decimal(q) is not None else None
128	        if to_decimal(q) is None or to_decimal(q) <= 0 or to_decimal(q) != int(to_decimal(q)):
129	            issues.append(f"{pos}: quantity must be a positive integer")
130	            continue
131	        line["pieces"] = int(q)
132	        if not mat:
133	            issues.append(f"{pos}: no material ({(matched.get(pos) or {}).get('reason')})")
134	            continue
135	        line["erp"] = erp_materials.get(norm_ref(mat), {})
136	        line["configuration"] = {k: line["erp"].get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")}
137	        cond = valid_condition(erp.get("conditions") or [], mat, scenario)
138	        price = scale_price(cond, int(q)) if cond else None
139	        if price is None:
140	            # say why: a missing condition, one outside the scenario date, or unreadable scales/price unit
141	            seen = [{k: c.get(k) for k in ("valid_from", "valid_to", "price_unit", "number_format", "currency")}
142	                    | {"scales": len(c.get("scales") or [])}
143	                    for c in erp.get("conditions") or [] if norm_ref(c.get("material")) == norm_ref(mat)]
144	            issues.append(f"{pos}: no valid price condition/scale for {mat}; conditions seen: {seen or 'none'}"
145	                          + (f"; chosen: {cond}" if cond else ""))
146	            continue
147	        currency = norm_ref((cond or {}).get("currency") or "EUR")
148	        if currency != "EUR":
149	            rate = to_decimal((mail.get("fx_by_key") or {}).get(norm_ref(cond.get("fx_key")), {}).get(currency)) if cond.get("fx_key") else to_decimal((mail.get("fx_fixing") or {}).get(currency))
150	            if rate is None:
151	                issues.append(f"{pos}: price in {currency}, no FX rate")
152	                continue
153	            price = price * rate
154	        line["base"] = round_cents(price)
155	        line["erp"] = erp_materials.get(norm_ref(mat), {})
156	        # the configurator lists the catalogue's own attribute values, so the submitter selects these
157	        line["configuration"] = {k: line["erp"].get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")}
158	
159	    priced = {pos: l for pos, l in lines.items() if "base" in l}
160	    omitted = [pos for pos in lines if pos not in priced]
161	
162	    # 2. order-level discount (threshold on undiscounted goods value of all priced positions)
163	    pct = to_decimal(discount.get("percent")) or D0
164	    threshold = to_decimal(discount.get("min_order_value"))
165	    order_value = round_cents(sum((l["pieces"] * l["base"] for l in priced.values()), D0))
166	    order_value_complete = len(priced) == len(lines)
167	    discount_unknown = threshold is not None and order_value < threshold and not order_value_complete
168	    if discount_unknown:
169	        issues.append("conditional discount unresolved: incomplete order value; 0% is a partial estimate")
170	    if threshold is not None and order_value < threshold:
171	        pct = D0
172	    d = pct / 100
173	
174	    # 3. shared setup pools, project bonus (allocations in cents)
175	    pools: dict[str, dict] = {}
176	    bonus: dict[str, dict] = {}
177	    for pos, l in lines.items():
178	        if l["keys"].get("setup_pool"):
179	            pools.setdefault(norm_ref(l["keys"]["setup_pool"]), {})[pos] = l
180	        if l["keys"].get("bonus_plan"):
181	            bonus.setdefault(norm_ref(l["keys"]["bonus_plan"]), {})[pos] = l
182	    for key, members in pools.items():
183	        fee = to_decimal((mail.get("setup_pools") or {}).get(key))
184	        masses = {pos: to_decimal(l.get("erp", {}).get("allocation_mass_g")) for pos, l in members.items()}
185	        weights = {pos: Decimal(l["pieces"]) * masses[pos] for pos, l in members.items()
186	                   if l.get("pieces") and masses[pos] is not None and masses[pos] >= 0}
187	        if fee is None or fee < 0 or len(weights) != len(members) or not any(weights.values()):
188	            for l in members.values():
189	                l["pool_unknown"] = True
190	            continue
191	        for pos, amount in allocate_cents(fee, weights).items():
192	            members[pos]["pool"] = amount
193	    for key, members in bonus.items():
194	        bands = (mail.get("project_bonus") or {}).get(key)
195	        if not bands or any("base" not in l for l in members.values()):
196	            for l in members.values():
197	                l["bonus_unknown"] = True
198	            continue
199	        values = {pos: l["pieces"] * l["base"] for pos, l in members.items()}
200	        credit = marginal_bonus(sum(values.values(), D0), bands)
201	        for pos, amount in allocate_cents(credit, values).items():
202	            members[pos]["bonus"] = amount
203	
204	    # 4. per-position surcharge, packaging, final price
205	    for pos, l in priced.items():
206	        n = Decimal(l["pieces"])
207	        rate = to_decimal((mail.get("price_indices") or {}).get(norm_ref(l["erp"].get("metal_index"))))
208	        mass = to_decimal(l["erp"].get("surcharge_mass_g"))
209	        l["mass_surcharge"] = mass / 1000 * rate if (rate is not None and mass is not None) else None
210	        tariff_key = l["keys"].get("packaging_tariff")
211	        tariff = to_decimal((mail.get("packaging_tariffs") or {}).get(norm_ref(tariff_key))) if tariff_key else D0
212	        carton = to_decimal(l["erp"].get("pieces_per_carton"))
213	        if tariff_key and (tariff is None or not carton):
214	            l["packaging_total"] = None
215	        else:
216	            l["packaging_total"] = (tariff * math.ceil(n / carton)) if tariff_key else D0
217	        scope = (mail.get("condition_rules") or {}).get(norm_ref(l["keys"].get("konditionsgruppe"))) \
218	            if l["keys"].get("konditionsgruppe") else "base_only"
219	        missing = []
220	        if l["mass_surcharge"] is None:
221	            missing.append("mass surcharge")
222	        if l["packaging_total"] is None:
223	            missing.append("packaging")
224	        if l.get("pool_unknown"):
225	            missing.append("shared setup")
226	        if l.get("bonus_unknown"):
227	            missing.append("project bonus")
228	        if scope not in ("base_only", "base_and_surcharge", "none"):
229	            missing.append("discount scope")
230	            scope = None
231	        if discount_unknown:
232	            missing.append("conditional discount")
233	        l["pricing_complete"] = not missing
234	        if missing:
235	            issues.append(f"{pos}: estimated final price; unresolved: {', '.join(missing)}")
236	        scope = scope or "base_only"
237	        base_factor = (1 - d) if scope in ("base_only", "base_and_surcharge") else Decimal(1)
238	        sur_factor = (1 - d) if scope == "base_and_surcharge" else Decimal(1)
239	        setup = (l.get("setup_fee") or D0) + l.get("pool", D0)
240	        extras = setup + (l["packaging_total"] or D0) - l.get("bonus", D0)
241	        final = l["base"] * base_factor + (l["mass_surcharge"] or D0) * sur_factor + extras / n
242	        l["unit_price"] = round_cents(final)
243	        l["surcharge_report"] = (round_cents(l["mass_surcharge"] + setup / n)
244	                                 if l["mass_surcharge"] is not None and not l.get("pool_unknown") else None)
245	        l["packaging_report"] = round_cents(l["packaging_total"] / n) if l["packaging_total"] is not None else None
246	        l["rebate_report"] = None if l.get("bonus_unknown") else round_cents(l.get("bonus", D0))
247	
248	    # 5. lead times: delivery commitment, else shared stock all-or-nothing per material
249	    demand: dict[str, int] = {}
250	    for l in lines.values():
251	        if not l.get("material") or not l.get("pieces"):
252	            continue
253	        demand[norm_ref(l["material"])] = demand.get(norm_ref(l["material"]), 0) + l["pieces"]
254	    stock = {norm_ref(k): v for k, v in (erp.get("stock") or {}).items()}
255	    for pos, l in priced.items():
256	        m = norm_ref(l["material"])
257	        commit = (mail.get("delivery_commitments") or {}).get(norm_ref(l["keys"].get("delivery_key"))) \
258	            if l["keys"].get("delivery_key") else None
259	        if commit and norm_ref(commit.get("material")) == m and to_decimal(commit.get("max_total_pieces")) is not None \
260	                and demand[m] <= to_decimal(commit["max_total_pieces"]) and to_decimal(commit.get("weeks")) is not None:
261	            l["lead"] = int(to_decimal(commit["weeks"]))
262	            continue
263	        free = to_decimal((stock.get(m) or {}).get("free"))
264	        stock_weeks = to_decimal(l["erp"].get("lead_time_stock_weeks"))
265	        prod_weeks = to_decimal(l["erp"].get("lead_time_production_weeks"))
266	        chosen = stock_weeks if (free is not None and free >= demand[m]) else prod_weeks
267	        l["lead"] = int(chosen) if chosen is not None else None
268	        if l["lead"] is None:
269	            issues.append(f"{pos}: lead time unknown")
270	
271	    # 6. answer
272	    blocked = [pos for pos in lines if (matched.get(pos) or {}).get("reason") == "only blocked matches"]
273	    decision = "no_bid" if blocked else "bid"
274	    positions = []
275	    for pos, l in priced.items():
276	        if l.get("lead") is None:
277	            omitted.append(pos)
278	            continue
279	        entry = {"position": pos, "material_number": l["material"], "quantity": l["pieces"],
280	                 "unit_price": float(l["unit_price"]), "lead_time_weeks": l["lead"],
281	                 "base_unit_price": float(l["base"])}
282	        for field, key in (("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharge_report"), ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging_report"),
283	                           ("rebate_total", "rebate_report")):
284	            if l.get(key) is not None:
285	                entry[field] = float(l[key])
286	        positions.append(entry)
287	        l["display"] = {k: de_number(Decimal(str(v))) for k, v in entry.items()
288	                        if k in ("unit_price", "base_unit_price", "surcharge_per_unit", "packaging_per_unit", "rebate_total")}
289	    total = round_cents(sum((Decimal(e["quantity"]) * Decimal(str(e["unit_price"])) for e in positions), D0))
290	    answer = {"tender_reference": brief.get("tender_reference") or (tender.get("meta") or {}).get("reference") or "",
291	              "decision": decision, "currency": "EUR", "discount_percent": float(pct if decision == "bid" or threshold is None else D0),
292	              "positions": positions if decision == "bid" else [], "total_net": float(total) if decision == "bid" else 0.0}
293	    if decision == "no_bid":
294	        issues.append(f"no active material for {blocked}: no_bid")
295	    return {"answer": answer, "omitted": sorted(set(omitted)) if decision == "bid" else [],
296	            "total_display": de_number(total if decision == "bid" else D0), "order_value": str(order_value),
297	            "order_value_complete": order_value_complete, "discount_resolved": not discount_unknown,
298	            "lines": [{k: (str(v) if isinstance(v, Decimal) else v) for k, v in l.items() if k != "erp"}
299	                      for l in lines.values()],
300	            "issues": issues}

3	"""Turns the saved ERP pages into materials, price conditions and stock, then matches each position in code:
4	an ACTIVE material whose bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification all equal the requirement exactly.
5	A requirement given as usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) gets twice the per-end reserve of the technical release for the
6	current revision added (amendments were already applied by the requirement analyst).
7	
8	Every saved page is extracted ONCE (cached in ctx.shared), with the shape its topic asks for (search list, material
9	record, price conditions, stock), so the ERP scraper can ask "which candidates did this search list show?" while it
10	works and the matcher and the coordinator's follow-up rounds only pay for new pages.
11	
12	Attributes read on a material's own record page beat values from a search list; its status (active / blocked) is only
13	taken from record pages, and record pages that disagree leave it unknown (never "blocked" by one misread).
14	Attributes a page does not show (e.g. certification in a search list) count as unverified, not as a mismatch.
15	
16	results["erp"] = {"materials": {no: {...}}, "conditions": [{...}], "stock": {no: {"free": "12", "locations": [...]}}}
17	results["materials"] = {position: {"material": no | None, "required": {...}, "candidates": [...], "reason": str,
18	                                   "unverified": [attribute, ...]}}

107	async def extract_erp(ctx, evidence=None) -> dict:
108	    """Extract every saved ERP page not extracted yet (one model call per page, in parallel); returns the cache
109	    {page key: {"kind", "topic", "url", "materials", "conditions", "stock"}}."""
110	    cache = ctx.shared.setdefault("erp.extracted", {})
111	    todo = [e for e in (pages(ctx, "erp") if evidence is None else evidence) if _key(e) not in cache]
112	
113	    async def one(e) -> dict:
114	        # A slow unrelated page must not block a finished search from scheduling material records.
115	        async with ctx.lock(f"erp.extract.{_key(e)!r}"):
116	            if _key(e) in cache:
117	                return cache[_key(e)]
118	            kind = page_kind(e.data.get("topic"))
119	            shape, keys, instruction = SHAPES[kind]
120	            out = await extract(ctx, instruction, shape, [page_block(e)], list_key=keys, chunk_size=25_000)
121	            result = {"kind": kind, "topic": e.data.get("topic"), "url": e.data.get("url"), "_incomplete": out.get("_incomplete", False),
122	                    **{k: out.get(k) or [] for k in ("materials", "conditions", "stock")}}
123	            if not result["_incomplete"]:
124	                cache[_key(e)] = result
125	                await publish(ctx, cache)
126	            return result
127	    replies = await asyncio.gather(*(one(e) for e in todo), return_exceptions=True)
128	    for r in replies:
129	        if isinstance(r, Exception):
130	            ctx.board.error("MaterialMatcher", f"ERP extraction: {type(r).__name__}")
131	    return cache

134	def merge_materials(extracted: list[dict], groups=()) -> dict:
135	    """{material no: attributes}: record pages first (they win), then search lists fill what is still missing.
136	    Status only from record pages; record pages that disagree on it leave it unknown. A material listed on the search
137	    page of a catalogue group (`groups`: the requirements' groups, named in the page topic) belongs to that group."""
138	    out: dict = {}
139	    status: dict[str, set] = {}
140	    order = sorted(reversed(extracted), key=lambda x: 0 if x.get("kind") == "record" else 1 if x.get("kind") == "any" else 2)
141	    for page in order:
142	        from_record = page.get("kind") in ("record", "any")
143	        for r in page.get("materials") or []:
144	            no = norm_ref(r.get("material"))
145	            if not no:
146	                continue
147	            cur = out.setdefault(no, {"material": str(r.get("material")).strip(), "seen_in": set()})
148	            cur["seen_in"].add(page.get("kind"))
149	            for k, v in r.items():
150	                if k == "is_active":
151	                    continue
152	                if not blank(v) and blank(cur.get(k)):
153	                    cur[k] = v
154	            if page.get("kind") == "list" and blank(cur.get("kataloggruppe")):
155	                topic = norm_ref(page.get("topic"))
156	                group = next((g for g in groups if norm_ref(g) and norm_ref(g) in topic), None)
157	                if group:
158	                    cur["kataloggruppe"] = group
159	            active = r.get("is_active")
160	            if active in (True, "true", False, "false"):
161	                status.setdefault(no, set()).add((from_record, active in (True, "true")))
162	    for no, cur in out.items():
163	        readings = status.get(no, set())
164	        record = {a for rec, a in readings if rec}
165	        listed = {a for rec, a in readings if not rec}
166	        values = record or listed
167	        cur["is_active"] = next(iter(values)) if len(values) == 1 else None
168	        cur["seen_in"] = sorted(cur["seen_in"])
169	    return out
170	
171	
172	FILLABLE = ("scales", "price_unit", "currency", "fx_key", "number_format")
173	
174	
175	def merge_condition_fragments(conditions: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
176	    """One condition read on several pages (header with validity / price unit, a separate scales register) arrives as
177	    fragments. A fragment without validity dates fills what the material's single dated condition lacks. Without this,
178	    the dated header (no scales) won as 'latest valid' and the position went unpriced (run_7732ba545b50b3a5, 01.05).
179	    Ambiguous cases (several dated conditions without scales) stay as they are."""
180	    def dated(c):
181	        return bool(c.get("valid_from") or c.get("valid_to"))
182	
183	    out = [dict(c) for c in conditions]
184	    for material in {norm_ref(c.get("material")) for c in out}:
185	        mine = [c for c in out if norm_ref(c.get("material")) == material]
186	        fragments = [c for c in mine if not dated(c)]
187	        targets = [c for c in mine if dated(c) and any(not c.get(k) for k in FILLABLE)]
188	        if not fragments or len(targets) != 1:
189	            continue
190	        target = targets[0]
191	        for frag in fragments:
192	            for key in FILLABLE:
193	                if not target.get(key) and frag.get(key):
194	                    target[key] = frag[key]
195	        if target.get("scales"):
196	            out = [c for c in out if not any(c is f for f in fragments)]
197	    return out

200	def erp_view(cache: dict, groups=()) -> dict:
201	    extracted = list(cache.values())
202	    materials = merge_materials(extracted, groups)
203	    conditions = merge_condition_fragments([c for page in extracted for c in page.get("conditions") or []])
204	    stock: dict = {}
205	    for page in extracted:                 # one row per (material, location); a re-read replaces
206	        for s in page.get("stock") or []:
207	            stock.setdefault(norm_ref(s.get("material")), {})[(norm_ref(s.get("plant")), norm_ref(s.get("location")), str(s.get("usable")))] = s
208	    out_stock = {}
209	    for no, rows in stock.items():
210	        free = sum((num(s.get("quantity")) or Decimal(0) for s in rows.values()
211	                    if str(s.get("usable")).lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")), Decimal(0))
212	        out_stock[no] = {"free": format(free, "f"), "locations": list(rows.values())}
213	    return {"materials": materials, "conditions": conditions, "stock": out_stock}

216	def required_stroke(req: dict, mail: dict, current_revision: str) -> Decimal | None:
217	    stroke = num(req.get("stroke"))
218	    if stroke is None or req.get("stroke_kind") != "usable":
219	        return stroke
220	    releases = (mail or {}).get("technical_release") or {}
221	    key = norm_ref(req.get("reserve_key"))
222	    match = releases.get(key) if key else None
223	    if match is None:
224	        same_rev = [r for r in releases.values() if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current_revision)]
225	        match = same_rev[0] if len(same_rev) == 1 else None
226	    if match and norm_ref(match.get("revision")) != norm_ref(current_revision):
227	        return None
228	    reserve = num((match or {}).get("reserve_mm_per_end"))
229	    return stroke + 2 * reserve if reserve is not None else None

232	MIN_KNOWN = 3      # of bore, stroke, pressure, mounting, certification: fewer read -> no evidence it fits
233	
234	
235	def check(m: dict, req: dict, stroke: Decimal | None, min_known: int = MIN_KNOWN) -> list[str] | None:
236	    """None if `m` contradicts the requirement or too little of it was read; else the attributes that could not be
237	    verified (not shown, or the usable-travel reserve unknown)."""
238	    if sum(not blank(m.get(a)) for a in ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")) < min_known:
239	        return None
240	    unverified = []
241	    for attr, equal in (("bore", same), ("pressure", same), ("mounting", text_equal), ("certification", text_equal)):
242	        if blank(m.get(attr)):
243	            unverified.append(attr)
244	        elif not equal(m.get(attr), req.get(attr)):
245	            return None
246	    have = num(m.get("stroke"))
247	    if have is None:
248	        unverified.append("stroke")
249	    elif stroke is not None:
250	        if have != stroke:
251	            return None
252	    else:                                  # usable travel, reserve unknown: nominal stroke must at least cover it
253	        usable = num(req.get("stroke"))
254	        if usable is None or have < usable:
255	            return None
256	        unverified.append("stroke")
257	    return unverified

259	
260	def match_positions(tender: dict, requirements: dict, materials: dict, mail: dict, current: str,
261	                    priced=frozenset()) -> dict:
262	    """`priced`: normalised numbers of materials with a price condition read (preferred among equal candidates)."""
263	    out = {}
264	    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
265	        pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
266	        ref = next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref"))), None)
267	        req = requirements.get(ref) if ref else None
268	        if not req:
269	            out[pos] = {"material": None, "reason": f"requirement {p.get('requirement_ref')} not found",
270	                        "candidates": [], "unverified": []}
271	            continue
272	        stroke = required_stroke(req, mail, current)
273	        group = norm_ref(req.get("kataloggruppe"))
274	        cands = []
275	        for m in materials.values():
276	            if group and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) != group:
277	                continue
278	            unverified = check(m, req, stroke)
279	            if unverified is None:
280	                continue
281	            active = m.get("is_active")
282	            cands.append({"material": m["material"], "status": m.get("status_code"), "unverified": unverified,
283	                          "stroke": m.get("stroke"),
284	                          "active": True if active in (True, "true") else False if active in (False, "false") else None})
285	        # best first: active before unknown status, fully verified before unverified, then the shortest fitting stroke
286	        usable = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is True and not c["unverified"]]
287	        usable.sort(key=lambda c: (c["active"] is not True, len(c["unverified"]),
288	                                   norm_ref(c["material"]) not in priced, num(c["stroke"]) or Decimal(0)))
289	        required = {k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "pressure", "mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe")}
290	        required["stroke"] = None if stroke is None else format(stroke.normalize(), "f")
291	        if usable:
292	            best = usable[0]
293	            reason = ("exact active match" if best["active"] and not best["unverified"] else
294	                      "exact match, status not read" if not best["unverified"] else
295	                      f"match, unverified: {', '.join(best['unverified'])}"
296	                      + ("" if best["active"] else ", status not read"))
297	            out[pos] = {"material": best["material"], "required": required, "candidates": cands, "reason": reason,
298	                        "unverified": best["unverified"] + ([] if best["active"] else ["status"])}
299	        else:
300	            out[pos] = {"material": None, "required": required, "candidates": cands, "unverified": [],
301	                        "reason": "only blocked matches" if cands and all(c["active"] is False and not c["unverified"] for c in cands) else "no verified active exact match among the ERP records read"}
302	    return out
303	
304	
305	def search_candidates(cache: dict, item: dict) -> list[str]:
306	    """Material numbers of the catalogue group `item` (a scraper work item) that fit one of its requirements on the
307	    pages read so far: the materials worth opening. Same tolerant check as the matcher (stroke may still differ by
308	    the reserve, so it only has to cover the usable travel / be unknown)."""
309	    group = norm_ref(item.get("group"))
310	    materials = merge_materials(list(cache.values()), [item.get("group")] if item.get("group") else [])
311	    out = []
312	    for m in materials.values():
313	        if group and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) != group:
314	            continue
315	        if group and not norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and "list" not in m.get("seen_in", []):
316	            continue
317	        for req in item.get("requirements") or []:
318	            loose = dict(req, stroke_kind="usable") if req.get("stroke_kind") == "usable" else req
319	            stroke = None if loose.get("stroke_kind") == "usable" else num(req.get("stroke"))
320	            if check(m, loose, stroke, min_known=0) is not None:      # unread attributes: open it and see
321	                out.append(m["material"])
322	                break
323	    return out
324

326	async def refresh(ctx) -> dict:
327	    """Extract new ERP pages, publish results["erp"] and match every position again; returns the match."""
328	    requirements = ctx.board.get("requirements") or {}
329	    groups = sorted({str(r.get("kataloggruppe")) for r in requirements.values() if r.get("kataloggruppe")})
330	    return await publish(ctx, await extract_erp(ctx))
331	
332	
333	async def publish(ctx, cache=None) -> dict:
334	    """Reconcile completed extractions without spending another model call."""
335	    requirements = ctx.board.get("requirements") or {}
336	    groups = sorted({str(r.get("kataloggruppe")) for r in requirements.values() if r.get("kataloggruppe")})
337	    erp = erp_view(ctx.shared.get("erp.extracted", {}) if cache is None else cache, groups)
338	    await ctx.board.set("erp", erp)
339	    mail = ctx.board.get("mail") or {}
340	    spec = ctx.board.get("spec") or {}
341	    priced = {norm_ref(c.get("material")) for c in erp["conditions"] if c.get("scales")}
342	    result = match_positions(ctx.board.get("tender") or {}, requirements, erp["materials"], mail,
343	                             spec.get("current", ""), priced)
344	    await ctx.board.set("materials", result)
345	    return result

349	class MaterialMatcher(Agent):
350	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
351	
352	    async def run(self) -> None:
353	        await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.erp", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
354	        if not pages(self.ctx, "erp"):
355	            raise RuntimeError("no ERP pages were saved")
356	        try:
357	            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements_final", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))
358	            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="mail", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))  # end reserves
359	        except TimeoutError:

361	        result = await refresh(self.ctx)
362	        self.log.info("materials: %s", {p: (r["material"], r["reason"]) for p, r in result.items()})

2	import asyncio
3	import json
4	import re
5	import os
6	import httpx
7	
8	CALL_TIMEOUT_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S", "55"))
9	HTTP_TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S, connect=8, write=15, pool=8)
10	
11	import models
12	from openai import APIConnectionError, APIStatusError
13	
14	
15	def parse_json(text: str):
16	    """The first JSON object/array in a model reply (tolerates ``` fences and chatter)."""
17	    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?|```$", "", text.strip(), flags=re.M).strip()
18	    for opener, closer in (("{", "}"), ("[", "]")):
19	        start, end = text.find(opener), text.rfind(closer)
20	        if start != -1 and end > start:
21	            try:
22	                return json.loads(text[start:end + 1])
23	            except ValueError:
24	                continue
25	    raise ValueError(f"no JSON in model reply: {text[:200]}")

27	
28	class LLM:
29	    def __init__(self, max_concurrent: int = 16):
30	        self._sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)   # team limit is 32 concurrent Qwen calls
31	        self._analysis_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max(1, max_concurrent // 2))
32	        self._client = None
33	        self.calls = 0
34	        self.tokens = {"prompt": 0, "completion": 0}
35	
36	    @property
37	    def client(self):
38	        self._client = self._client or models.qwen().with_options(timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT, max_retries=0)
39	        return self._client
40	
41	    async def chat(self, messages: list[dict], *, tools: list[dict] | None = None, model: str = models.QWEN_MODEL,
42	                   think: bool = False, **kwargs):
43	        """One chat completion; returns the message (`.content`, `.tool_calls`). `think=True` lets Qwen run its
44	        separate reasoning pass (slower, more tokens): use it for judgement calls, not for plain extraction."""
45	        args = dict(model=model, messages=messages, **kwargs)
46	        args.setdefault("temperature", 0)
47	        if not think and model == models.QWEN_MODEL:
48	            args["extra_body"] = {**(args.get("extra_body") or {}), **models.NO_THINKING}
49	        if tools:
50	            args["tools"] = tools
51	        async with self._analysis_sem, self._sem:
52	            # Bound each attempt, including providers that leave a connection open without replying.
53	            for attempt in range(2):
54	                try:
55	                    async with asyncio.timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S):
56	                        reply = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**args)
57	                    break
58	                except (TimeoutError, models.httpx.TransportError, APIConnectionError):
59	                    if attempt:
60	                        raise
61	                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
62	                except APIStatusError as error:
63	                    if attempt or (error.status_code < 500 and error.status_code != 429):
64	                        raise
65	                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
66	        self.calls += 1
67	        if reply.usage:
68	            self.tokens["prompt"] += reply.usage.prompt_tokens or 0
69	            self.tokens["completion"] += reply.usage.completion_tokens or 0
70	        return reply.choices[0].message
71	
72	    async def ask(self, system: str, user: str, **kwargs) -> str:
73	        message = await self.chat([{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}], **kwargs)
74	        return message.content or ""
75	
76	    async def ask_json(self, system: str, user: str, retries: int = 1, **kwargs):
77	        """Ask for JSON; re-ask once with the parse error if the reply is not valid."""
78	        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
79	        kwargs.setdefault("response_format", {"type": "json_object"})    # Qwen then always answers with JSON
80	        for _ in range(retries + 1):
81	            reply = (await self.chat(messages, **kwargs)).content or ""
82	            try:
83	                return parse_json(reply)
84	            except ValueError as error:
85	                messages += [{"role": "assistant", "content": reply},
86	                             {"role": "user", "content": f"Invalid: {error}. Reply with valid JSON only."}]
87	        raise ValueError("model did not return valid JSON")

1	"""Helpers for analysts: read the pages the scrapers saved and let the model turn them into structured JSON.
2	
3	The scrapers decide which pages matter (`read_page` with a topic -> Evidence kind "<role>.page"); analysts send that
4	text plus a JSON shape to the model and validate the reply in code. Long texts are split at page boundaries.
5	"""
6	import asyncio
7	import logging
8	import re
9	
10	log = logging.getLogger("extract")
11	
12	SYSTEM = ("Extract facts from German business web pages for bid calculation. Copy values exactly as shown (keep "
13	          "number strings with locale marker like '(en-US)', keep units). Never invent; value not on page -> null. "
14	          "Reply JSON only, in requested shape.")
15	CHUNK = 40_000
16	
17	
18	def pages(ctx, role: str) -> list:
19	    """Saved page evidence of a role ('tender', 'spec', 'erp', 'mail'), oldest first, exact duplicates dropped."""
20	    seen, out = set(), []
21	    for e in ctx.board.query(f"{role}.page"):
22	        key = (e.data.get("url"), hash(e.data.get("text", "")))
23	        if key not in seen:
24	            seen.add(key)
25	            out.append(e)
26	    from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
27	    for e in ctx.board.query(role + ".", prefix=True):
28	        if not e.kind.endswith(".page") and e.data.get("_observed_text"):
29	            key = (e.source, hash(e.data["_observed_text"]))
30	            if key not in seen:
31	                seen.add(key)
32	                out.append(Evidence(role + ".page", e.site, {"topic": e.kind, "url": e.source,
33	                                  "text": e.data["_observed_text"]}, source=e.source, author=e.author))
34	    return out

42	def records(ctx, kind_prefix: str) -> list[dict]:
43	    """Facts the browsing model recorded directly with `record` (kind starting with the prefix)."""
44	    return [{"kind": e.kind, **(e.data or {}), "_source": e.source, "_note": e.note}
45	            for e in ctx.board.query(kind_prefix, prefix=True) if not e.kind.endswith(".page")]

48	PAGE_BREAK = "\n\n----- next page -----\n\n"
49	
50	
51	def chunks(blocks: list[str], size: int = CHUNK) -> list[str]:
52	    """Pack blocks into chunks of about `size` characters; a long block is split at its page breaks first (so a
53	    paged list is cut between pages, not inside an entry), and only then at `size`."""
54	    out, cur = [], ""
55	    for b in blocks:
56	        head = b.split("\n", 1)[0] + "\n" if b.startswith("=== PAGE") else ""
57	        parts = b.split(PAGE_BREAK)
58	        pieces = []
59	        for i, part in enumerate(parts):
60	            part = part if i == 0 else head + part
61	            pieces += [part[j:j + size] for j in range(0, len(part), size)] or [""]
62	        for piece in pieces:
63	            if cur and len(cur) + len(piece) > size:
64	                out.append(cur)
65	                cur = ""
66	            cur += piece + "\n\n"
67	    if cur.strip():
68	        out.append(cur)
69	    return out

71	
72	async def extract(ctx, instruction: str, shape: str, blocks: list[str], *, list_key: str | tuple | None = None,
73	                  context: str = "", chunk_size: int = CHUNK) -> dict:
74	    """Ask the model to extract `shape` from the blocks. With `list_key` (one key or several), chunks are processed in
75	    parallel and the lists under those keys are concatenated (for long paged lists); otherwise one call."""
76	    keys = (list_key,) if isinstance(list_key, str) else tuple(list_key or ())
77	    if not blocks:
78	        return {k: [] for k in keys}
79	    user_head = f"{instruction}\n\nJSON shape:\n{shape}\n" + (f"\nContext:\n{context}\n" if context else "")
80	    if not keys:
81	        out = await ctx.llm.ask_json(SYSTEM, user_head + "\nPAGES:\n" + "\n\n".join(blocks))
82	        return out if isinstance(out, dict) else {}
83	    parts = chunks(blocks, chunk_size)
84	    replies = await asyncio.gather(*(ctx.llm.ask_json(SYSTEM, user_head + "\nPAGES:\n" + p) for p in parts),
85	                                   return_exceptions=True)
86	    merged: dict = {k: [] for k in keys}
87	    for r in replies:
88	        if isinstance(r, Exception):
89	            merged["_incomplete"] = True
90	            log.warning("extract chunk failed: %s", type(r).__name__)
91	            continue
92	        if isinstance(r, list) and len(keys) == 1:
93	            merged[keys[0]] += r
94	        elif isinstance(r, dict):
95	            for k, v in r.items():
96	                if k in keys:
97	                    merged[k] += v if isinstance(v, list) else []
98	                elif v not in (None, "", [], {}):
99	                    merged.setdefault(k, v)
100	    return merged

103	def brief_section(brief: str, *names: str) -> str:
104	    """The text of markdown sections whose heading contains one of `names` (case-insensitive)."""
105	    out, keep = [], False
106	    for line in brief.splitlines():
107	        if line.startswith("#"):
108	            keep = any(n.lower() in line.lower() for n in names)
109	        if keep:
110	            out.append(line)
111	    return "\n".join(out).strip()

114	def brief_intro(brief: str, limit: int = 1500) -> str:
115	    """The brief up to its first second-level section: who we are and what the tender is."""
116	    head = re.split(r"\n##\s", brief, maxsplit=1)[0]
117	    return head.strip()[:limit]

60	def valid_messages(messages: list[dict], ref: str, scenario: datetime | None, senders: dict, domain: str) -> list[dict]:
61	    out = []
62	    for m in messages:
63	        if m.get("is_draft") in (True, "true") or norm_ref(m.get("reference")) != norm_ref(ref):
64	            continue
65	        want = _local(senders.get(m.get("topic"), ""))
66	        if not want or _local(m.get("sender")) != want:
67	            continue
68	        if not domain or _domain(m.get("sender")) != domain:
69	            continue
70	        date = to_datetime(m.get("date"))
71	        if not ref or scenario is None or date is None or date > scenario:
72	            continue
73	        out.append(m)
74	    return sorted(out, key=lambda m: to_datetime(m.get("date")) or EPOCH)

77	def latest_entries(messages: list[dict], topic: str) -> dict:
78	    """{key: entry} from the newest valid message per key (messages sorted oldest first)."""
79	    out = {}
80	    for m in messages:
81	        if m.get("topic") == topic:
82	            for e in m.get("entries") or []:
83	                if e.get("key") or e.get("index") or e.get("currency"):
84	                    out[norm_ref(e.get("key") or e.get("index") or e.get("currency"))] = e | {"_date": m.get("date")}
85	    return out

88	def summarise(messages: list[dict], scenario: datetime | None) -> dict:
89	    s = lambda v: None if v in (None, "") else format(to_decimal(v).normalize(), "f") if to_decimal(v) is not None else None  # noqa: E731
90	    mail = {"condition_rules": {k: e.get("discount_scope") for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "condition_rules").items()},
91	            "technical_release": {k: {"revision": e.get("revision"), "reserve_mm_per_end": s(e.get("reserve_mm_per_end"))}
92	                                  for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "technical_release").items()},
93	            "packaging_tariffs": {k: s(e.get("eur_per_carton")) for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "packaging_tariffs").items()},
94	            "delivery_commitments": {k: {"material": e.get("material"), "weeks": s(e.get("weeks")),
95	                                         "max_total_pieces": s(e.get("max_total_pieces"))}
96	                                     for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "delivery_commitments").items()},
97	            "setup_pools": {k: s(e.get("pool_fee_eur")) for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "setup_pools").items()},
98	            "project_bonus": {k: [{"from": s(b.get("from_eur")) or "0", "to": s(b.get("to_eur")), "percent": s(b.get("percent"))}
99	                                  for b in e.get("bands") or []]
100	                              for k, e in latest_entries(messages, "project_bonus").items()},
101	            "fx_fixing": {}, "fx_by_key": {}, "price_indices": {}}
102	    fx_entries = latest_entries(messages, "fx_fixing")
103	    currencies = {}
104	    for key, e in fx_entries.items():
105	        currency = norm_ref(e.get("currency"))
106	        if currency:
107	            rate = s(e.get("eur_per_currency_unit"))
108	            mail["fx_by_key"].setdefault(key, {})[currency] = rate
109	            currencies.setdefault(currency, []).append(rate)
110	    for currency, rates in currencies.items():
111	        if len(set(rates)) == 1:
112	            mail["fx_fixing"][currency] = rates[0]
113	    index_messages = [m for m in messages if m.get("topic") == "price_indices"]
114	    # Pick the governing message first; never resurrect an older rate outside its replacement's windows.
115	    if index_messages:
116	        for e in index_messages[-1].get("entries") or []:
117	            start, end = to_datetime(e.get("valid_from")), validity_end(e.get("valid_to"))
118	            inside = scenario is not None and (start is None or start <= scenario) and (end is None or scenario <= end)
119	            if inside and e.get("index"):
120	                mail["price_indices"][norm_ref(e["index"])] = s(e.get("eur_per_kg"))
121	    return mail

149	async def publish(ctx) -> list[dict]:
150	    cache = ctx.shared.setdefault("mail.extracted", {})
151	    facts = ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
152	    ref, scenario = facts.get("tender_reference", ""), to_datetime(facts.get("scenario_date"))
153	    senders = {k: v for k, v in (facts.get("authorized_senders") or {}).items() if v}

169	        if invalid_approval:

171	            ctx.board.error("DiscountAnalyzer", "Latest discount approval has invalid numeric terms; recollect it")

2	"""Requirements of the specification revision marked current, with the tender Q&A's scoped amendments applied.
3	
4	results["spec"] = {"revisions": [{"revision", "date", "status", "is_current"}], "current": "R-..."}
5	results["requirements"] = {ref: {"bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind": "nominal"|"usable", "pressure", "mounting",
6	    "certification", "kataloggruppe", "pieces_per_set", "reserve_key", "revision", "amended": [..]}}
7	Numbers are plain strings without locale noise (e.g. "200"); stroke is the value after amendments (usable travel if
8	stroke_kind == "usable"; the matcher adds the end reserves from the technical release mail).
9	It is written up to three times: early, as soon as a requirement table page is saved (so the ERP search can start
10	while the spec scraper finishes), then from all spec pages, then with amendments, followed by
11	results["requirements_final"] = True.
12	"""
13	import asyncio
14	import logging
15	
16	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
17	from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
18	from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_decimal
19	
20	log = logging.getLogger("RequirementAnalyzer")
21	
22	SHAPE = """{"revisions": [{"revision": "", "date": "ISO date (mind the stated MM/DD or DD/MM order)", "status": "as shown",
23	               "is_current": true/false}],
24	 "requirements": [{"revision": "revision these values belong to", "ref": "requirement reference as shown",
25	   "bore": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "stroke": "number as shown incl. locale marker",
26	   "stroke_kind": "nominal, or usable if the stroke is a usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) that needs end reserves",
27	   "pressure": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
28	   "kataloggruppe": "catalogue group to search in the ERP", "pieces_per_set": "pieces per set (Satz) if stated, else null",
29	   "reserve_key": "technical release / end reserve key if referenced, else null",
30	   "original_text": "the requirement's original wording if shown"}]}"""
31	
32	NUMERIC = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure")
33	
34	
35	def plain_number(text) -> str | None:
36	    value = to_decimal(text)
37	    return None if value is None else format(value.normalize(), "f")
38

40	def apply_amendments(requirements: dict, current: str, clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
41	    """Latest dated amendment per (requirement, attribute) that names the current revision; other revisions ignored."""
42	    fields = {"bore": ("bohrung", "bore", "durchmesser"), "stroke": ("hub", "stroke", "stellweg", "weg"),
43	              "pressure": ("druck", "pressure"), "mounting": ("befestigung", "mounting"),
44	              "certification": ("zertifi", "certification", "prüf")}
45	    amendments = sorted((c for c in clarifications if c.get("amendment")),
46	                        key=lambda c: to_datetime(c.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
47	    for c in amendments:
48	        a = c["amendment"]
49	        if norm_ref(a.get("revision")) != norm_ref(current):
50	            continue
51	        req = requirements.get(next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(a.get("requirement"))), ""))
52	        attr = next((f for f, words in fields.items() if any(w in (a.get("attribute") or "").lower() for w in words)), None)
53	        if req is None or attr is None or a.get("value") in (None, ""):
54	            continue
55	        req[attr] = plain_number(a["value"]) if attr in NUMERIC else str(a["value"]).strip()
56	        req.setdefault("amended", []).append(f"{attr} by Q&A {c.get('number')} ({c.get('date')})")
57	    return requirements
58

60	async def analyse(ctx) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
61	    """Extract pages independently and publish every completed requirement table immediately."""
62	    cache = ctx.shared.setdefault("spec.extracted", {})
63	    async with ctx.lock("spec.extract"):
64	        async def one(e):
65	            key = (e.data.get("url"), hash(e.data.get("text", "")))
66	            if key in cache:
67	                return
68	            try:
69	                out = await extract(ctx, "Extract specification revision statuses and requirement rows. Mark current only with explicit valid/current status; never superseded.",
70	                                    SHAPE, [page_block(e)], list_key=("requirements", "revisions"))
71	                if out.get("_incomplete"):
72	                    return
73	                cache[key] = out
74	                revisions, current, requirements = merge_spec(ctx)
75	                if current:
76	                    await ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions":revisions, "current":current})
77	                    ctx.shared["spec.base_requirements"] = requirements
78	                    await publish(ctx)
79	            except Exception as error:
80	                ctx.board.error("RequirementAnalyzer", f"spec extraction: {type(error).__name__}")
81	        await asyncio.gather(*(one(e) for e in pages(ctx, "spec")))
82	    return merge_spec(ctx)

85	def merge_spec(ctx) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
86	    cache = ctx.shared.get("spec.extracted", {})
87	    completed = [cache.get((e.data.get("url"), hash(e.data.get("text", ""))), {}) for e in pages(ctx, "spec")]
88	    revisions = [r for page in completed for r in page.get("revisions") or []]
89	    flagged = [r for r in revisions if r.get("is_current") is True]
90	    flagged.sort(key=lambda r: to_datetime(r.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
91	    current = flagged[-1]["revision"] if flagged else ""
92	    rows = [r for page in completed for r in page.get("requirements") or []]
93	    rows = [r for r in rows if current and norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current)]
94	    requirements = {}
95	    for r in rows:
96	        ref = str(r.get("ref") or "").strip()
97	        if not ref:
98	            continue
99	        entry = {k: r.get(k) for k in ("mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe", "reserve_key", "original_text")}
100	        entry |= {k: plain_number(r.get(k)) for k in NUMERIC}
101	        entry["stroke_kind"] = "usable" if "usable" in str(r.get("stroke_kind") or "").lower() else "nominal"
102	        entry["pieces_per_set"] = plain_number(r.get("pieces_per_set")) if r.get("pieces_per_set") else None
103	        entry["revision"] = r.get("revision") or current
104	        merged = requirements.setdefault(ref, {})
105	        merged.update({k: v for k, v in entry.items() if v not in (None, "")})
106	    return revisions, current, requirements

109	async def refresh(ctx, wait_tender: float = 0) -> dict:
110	    """Analyse the saved spec pages, apply the tender's amendments; publishes spec, requirements,
111	    requirements_final. `wait_tender`: seconds to wait for the tender analysis (amendments come from its Q&A)."""
112	    if not pages(ctx, "spec"):
113	        raise RuntimeError("no specification pages were saved")
114	    revisions, current, requirements = await analyse(ctx)

2	"""Turns the saved tender pages into positions and Q&A records, then applies the quantity rules in code.

9	}

11	Rule: tender quantity, overridden by the latest dated clarification that changes it; withdrawn answers are ignored.

22	POSITIONS_SHAPE = """{"meta": {"reference": "", "title": "", "deadline": "", "timezone": ""},

24	                "requirement_ref": "requirement reference as shown"}]}"""

27	  "number": "Q&A number", "date": "UTC ISO timestamp if shown, else as shown", "question": "", "answer": "full answer text",
28	  "kind": "quantity_change | withdrawal | technical_amendment | commercial_keys | setup_fee | other",
29	  "positions": ["position numbers this answer applies to"],
30	  "new_quantity": "new total quantity as shown, or null", "quantity_unit": "unit of that quantity or null",
31	  "withdraws": ["numbers of earlier answers this one EXPLICITLY withdraws/retracts (zurückgezogen); a newer value replacing an older one is not a withdrawal"],
32	  "amendment": {"document": "", "revision": "", "requirement": "", "attribute": "", "value": ""} or null,
33	  "keys": {"konditionsgruppe": null, "packaging_tariff": null, "delivery_key": null, "setup_pool": null, "bonus_plan": null},

38	    """Numbers of answers explicitly withdrawn by a withdrawal answer (a newer value is not a withdrawal)."""
39	    return {norm_ref(n) for c in clarifications if c.get("kind") == "withdrawal" for n in (c.get("withdraws") or [])}

42	def final_quantities(positions: list[dict], clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
43	    withdrawn = withdrawn_numbers(clarifications)
44	    out = {}
45	    for p in positions:
46	        pos = str(p.get("position") or "").strip()
47	        if not pos:
48	            continue
49	        qty, basis = to_int(p.get("quantity")), "tender"
50	        changes = [c for c in clarifications
51	                   if c.get("new_quantity") not in (None, "") and norm_ref(c.get("number")) not in withdrawn
52	                   and pos in [str(x).strip() for x in (c.get("positions") or [])]]
53	        changes.sort(key=lambda c: (to_datetime(c.get("date")) is not None, to_datetime(c.get("date")) or 0,
54	                                    to_int(c.get("number")) or 0))
55	        if changes:
56	            latest = changes[-1]
57	            qty, basis = to_int(latest.get("new_quantity")), f"Q&A {latest.get('number')}"

68	    cache = ctx.shared.get("tender.extracted", {})

76	                if pos:

31	    for site in task.get("access") or []:
32	        for key, value in (site.get("credentials") or {}).items():
33	            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) >= 4:

40	    bidder data verbatim, sender local parts as written in the brief ('name@' or '/name')."""
41	    flat = " ".join(str(brief or "").split())

47	    facts["authorized_senders"] = {topic: local for topic, local in senders.items()
48	                                   if isinstance(local, str) and local.strip("@ ")

51	    if director and not re.search(rf"(?<![\w.]){re.escape(director)}@", flat):

1	<#
2	.SYNOPSIS
3	  Start a sandbox test run of this package (public data, unscored) and optionally follow its key log lines.
4	
5	.EXAMPLE
6	  .\scripts\test-run.ps1                 # unit tests, then start the run; prints its id and page
7	  .\scripts\test-run.ps1 -Follow         # ... and stream milestones + failures until the run ends
8	  .\scripts\test-run.ps1 -SkipTests -Follow
9	
10	  From Git Bash / a Claude Code Monitor:
11	  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test-run.ps1 -Follow
12	#>
13	param(
14	    [switch]$Follow,       # stream milestone/failure lines of the run's log until it ends
15	    [switch]$SkipTests,    # skip the local unit tests before packing
16	    [switch]$Open,         # open the run page in the browser
17	    [switch]$DryRun        # only show what would be packed
18	)
19	$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
20	Set-Location (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)
21	
22	# Lines worth seeing while a run goes: phases, scraper/analyst results, the submission, and every kind of failure.
23	$Milestones = 'browse done|swarm phase|site roles|brief facts|early requirements|current revision|positions,|' +
24	              'discount \{|materials:|verification:|submission attempt|answer \(entered|model calls:|nothing saved|' +
25	              'board after collect|gaps|follow-up|candidates|tip for|guard .*->|' +
26	              'tab job failed|timed out|failed|Traceback|FATAL|CRITICAL|No lifecycle events'
27	
28	if (-not $SkipTests) {
29	    Write-Host "== unit tests"
30	    $tests = cmd /c "uv run --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -q 2>&1"
31	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $tests | Select-Object -Last 40; throw "unit tests failed: not starting a test run" }
32	    $tests | Select-String -Pattern '^Ran \d+ tests|^OK' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }
33	}
34	
35	if ($DryRun) {
36	    atira test-run . --dry-run
37	    exit $LASTEXITCODE
38	}
39	
40	Write-Host "== starting test run"
41	$openFlag = if ($Open) { "" } else { "--no-open" }
42	# atira prints the run id on stderr: merge it in cmd (PowerShell 5.1 would turn stderr lines into errors).
43	$out = (cmd /c "atira test-run . $openFlag 2>&1" | Out-String)
44	Write-Host $out.Trim()
45	$runId = [regex]::Match($out, 'run_[0-9a-f]{16}').Value
46	if (-not $runId) { throw "no run id in the atira output" }

48	Write-Host "== run $runId  https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/runs/$runId"
49	if (-not $Follow) {

51	    exit 0
52	}

54	# The whole log goes to .swarm/runs/<run>-log.md (git-ignored, never packaged; see CLAUDE.md "Run data"), the milestones
55	# to the console. cmd merges stderr into stdout without PowerShell 5.1 wrapping each stderr line as an error record.

60	    Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile $_
61	    if ($_ -match $Milestones) { $_ }
62	}
