1	<#
2	.SYNOPSIS
3	  Save a run's full log locally as Markdown, so it can be read and searched without waiting for the platform.
4	
5	  Writes .swarm/runs/<run>-log.md (whole log, replaced on every pull) and adds a line to .swarm/runs/<run>.md (notes:
6	  status, scores and MCP results go there). .swarm/ is git-ignored and never packaged: run logs hold scenario
7	  values, which must never get into the package.
8	
9	.EXAMPLE
10	  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc            # once (run ended or a snapshot)
11	  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc -Follow    # keep writing until the run ends
12	
13	  From Git Bash / a Claude Code Monitor:
14	  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/pull-run.ps1 <run> -Follow
15	#>
16	param(
17	    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$RunId,
18	    [switch]$Follow
19	)
20	$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
21	Set-Location (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)
22	$dir = ".swarm/runs"
23	New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null
24	$notes = "$dir/$RunId.md"
25	$logFile = "$dir/$RunId-log.md"
26	$now = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm 'UTC'")
27	
28	# cmd merges stderr (atira writes progress there) without PowerShell 5.1 turning each line into an error record
29	$status = (cmd /c "atira status 2>&1" | Select-String -SimpleMatch $RunId | Select-Object -First 1)
30	$status = if ($status) { $status.Line.Trim() } else { "(not in atira status)" }
31	
32	if (-not (Test-Path $notes)) {
33	    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $notes "# $RunId`n`nFull log: [$RunId-log.md]($RunId-log.md). Notes and MCP pulls below, newest last.`n"
34	}
35	Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $notes "`n## $now - log pulled`n`nStatus: $status`n"
36	
37	# The platform keeps only the tail of a long log: a later pull can hold FEWER early lines than an earlier one. So the
38	# file is never replaced: lines it does not have yet are appended (in the order the platform returns them).
39	$known = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]'
40	if (Test-Path $logFile) {
41	    Get-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile | Where-Object { $_ -ne '```' } | ForEach-Object { [void]$known.Add($_) }
42	    $kept = Get-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile | Where-Object { $_ -ne '```' }
43	    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile $kept
44	} else {
45	    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile ("# $RunId log`n`nLines from every pull, merged (the platform keeps only the tail " +
46	                                         "of a long log, so early lines exist only in earlier pulls).`n`n" + '```text')
47	}
48	Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile "--- pull $now ($status) ---"
49	$add = { param($line) if ($known.Add($line)) { Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile $line } }
50	if ($Follow) {
51	    cmd /c "atira logs $RunId --follow 2>&1" | ForEach-Object { & $add $_; $_ }
52	} else {
53	    cmd /c "atira logs $RunId 2>&1" | ForEach-Object { & $add $_ }
54	}
55	Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $logFile '```'
56	$lines = (Get-Content $logFile | Measure-Object -Line).Lines
57	Write-Host "saved $logFile ($lines lines) and $notes"

1	"""close_hung_tabs against a real Chromium: a tab blocked by a request that never answers is closed, a working tab is
2	kept (sandbox: one hung tab made every browser-use connect to that browser time out)."""
3	import asyncio
4	import http.server
5	import json
6	import socket
7	import threading
8	import unittest
9	import urllib.request
10	from unittest import mock
11	
12	from swarm import browser_agent as ba
13	
14	
15	class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
16	    def log_message(self, *args):
17	        pass
18	
19	    def do_GET(self):
20	        if self.path.startswith("/hang"):
21	            threading.Event().wait(120)      # never answers
22	            return
23	        body = (b"<html><body>ok<script>if (location.search === '?block') { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); "
24	                b"x.open('GET', '/hang', false); x.send(); }</script></body></html>")
25	        self.send_response(200)
26	        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html")
27	        self.end_headers()
28	        self.wfile.write(body)
29	
30	
31	def free_port() -> int:
32	    with socket.socket() as s:
33	        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
34	        return s.getsockname()[1]
35	
36	
37	class HungTabs(unittest.TestCase):
38	    def test_hung_tab_is_closed_and_working_tab_kept(self):
39	        from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
40	
41	        server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
42	        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
43	        base, port = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}", free_port()
44	
45	        async def run():
46	            async with async_playwright() as p:
47	                browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=[f"--remote-debugging-port={port}"])
48	                context = await browser.new_context()
49	                good, bad = await context.new_page(), await context.new_page()
50	                await good.goto(base + "/")
51	                await bad.goto(base + "/")
52	                await bad.evaluate(f"setTimeout(() => location.href = '{base}/?block', 10)")
53	                await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
54	                with mock.patch.object(ba.browsers, "cdp_urls", return_value=[f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"]), \
55	                        mock.patch.object(ba, "TAB_PROBE_S", 3):
56	                    closed = await ba.close_hung_tabs(0)
57	                await asyncio.sleep(1)
58	                listed = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/json/list", timeout=5))
59	                urls = sorted(t["url"] for t in listed if t["type"] == "page" and t["url"].startswith(base))
60	                await browser.close()
61	                return closed, urls
62	
63	        closed, urls = asyncio.run(run())
64	        server.shutdown()
65	        self.assertEqual(len(closed), 1)
66	        self.assertEqual(urls, [base + "/"])             # the working tab is still there, the hung one gone
67	
68

232	    """One per browse(): `sweep(evaluate)` clears the page once; `loop(evaluate)` sweeps until cancelled.
233	    `evaluate(js, *args)` runs a JS arrow function in the agent's current page."""
234	
235	    def __init__(self, ctx, author: str, careful: bool = False, fill=None):
236	        """`fill(pairs, then_click, item_id)` sets fields inside the observed gate only."""
237	        self.ctx, self.author, self.careful = ctx, author, careful
238	        self._fill = fill
239	        self._fresh: dict = {}             # decisions that are not cached (fills copying a code): used once
240	        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
241	        self._tries: dict[str, int] = {}
242	        self.actions = 0
243	
244	    async def fill(self, evaluate, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]], then_click: str, item_id: int) -> str:
245	        if self._fill is not None:
246	            return await self._fill(pairs, then_click, item_id)
247	        from swarm.forms import fill_fields, scoped_evaluator
248	        return await fill_fields(scoped_evaluator(evaluate, item_id), pairs, "", then_click)

250	    def _decide(self, site: str, items: list[dict]) -> dict[int, dict]:
251	        """Decisions for the scanned items that are known now (cached, or just classified for this guard). Unknown
252	        items are sent to the model in the background (one call per new item kind across all agents) and handled by
253	        a later sweep: a sweep never waits for the model, so the agent's step is never held up by it."""
254	        out, unknown = {}, []
255	        for item in items:
256	            key = (site, signature(item))
257	            if key in _DECISIONS:
258	                out[item["id"]] = _DECISIONS[key]
259	            elif key in self._fresh:
260	                observed, decision = self._fresh.pop(key)
261	                if observed == item.get("text"):
262	                    out[item["id"]] = decision
263	            elif key not in _PENDING:
264	                unknown.append((key, item))
265	        if unknown:
266	            for key, _ in unknown:
267	                _PENDING[key] = True
268	            task = asyncio.create_task(self._classify(site, unknown))
269	            _TASKS.add(task)                    # finishes even after this browse ended: other agents use the answer
270	            task.add_done_callback(_TASKS.discard)
271	        return out
272	
273	    async def _classify(self, site: str, unknown: list[tuple]) -> None:
274	        try:
275	            shown = [{k: item[k] for k in ("id", "kind", "text", "buttons", "fields")} for _, item in unknown]
276	            reply = await asyncio.wait_for(
277	                self.ctx.llm.ask_json(SYSTEM, json.dumps({"items": shown}, ensure_ascii=False)), CLASSIFY_TIMEOUT_S)
278	            by_id = {d.get("id"): d for d in (reply or {}).get("items") or [] if isinstance(d, dict)}
279	            for key, item in unknown:

281	                if decision.get("action") != "fill" or cacheable_fill(decision):
282	                    _DECISIONS[key] = decision      # a fill that copies a displayed code: asked again each time
283	                else:
284	                    self._fresh[key] = (item.get("text"), decision)
285	                log.info("guard %s: %s %s -> %s %s", site, item["kind"], item["text"][:80], decision.get("action"),
286	                         decision.get("kind"))
287	        except Exception as error:              # model slow or failing: the agent handles these items itself
288	            log.debug("guard classification failed: %s", error)

11	def prepare_answer(answer: dict, schema: dict | None = None) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
12	    """Keep independent valid fields, omit malformed lines, and recompute the submitted total.
13	
14	    Never invent replacement business values. The runtime schema is the final authority.
15	    """
16	    answer = deepcopy(answer)
17	    changes = []
18	    item_schema = ((schema or {}).get('properties', {}).get('positions', {}).get('items') or {})
19	    required = set(item_schema.get('required') or ('position', 'material_number', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'lead_time_weeks'))
20	    kept, seen = [], set()
21	    for entry in answer.get('positions') or []:
22	        pos = entry.get('position')
23	        malformed = not pos or pos in seen
24	        for name, value in list(entry.items()):
25	            prop = item_schema.get('properties', {}).get(name)
26	            bad = bool(prop and list(Draft202012Validator(prop).iter_errors(value)))
27	            if name in ('quantity', 'lead_time_weeks'):
28	                bad |= isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0
29	            elif name in ('unit_price','base_unit_price','surcharge_per_unit','packaging_per_unit','rebate_total'):
30	                try:
31	                    number = Decimal(str(value))
32	                    bad |= not number.is_finite() or number < 0
33	                except (ValueError, TypeError, ArithmeticError):
34	                    bad = True
35	            if bad:
36	                if name in required:
37	                    malformed = True
38	                else:
39	                    entry.pop(name)
40	                    changes.append(f'{pos}: omitted invalid optional {name}')
41	        malformed |= not required.issubset(entry)
42	        if item_schema and list(Draft202012Validator(item_schema).iter_errors(entry)):
43	            malformed = True
44	        if malformed:
45	            changes.append(f'{pos}: omitted malformed or duplicate position')
46	        else:
47	            kept.append(entry)
48	            seen.add(pos)
49	    if answer.get('decision') == 'no_bid':
50	        kept = []
51	    answer['positions'] = kept
52	    answer['total_net'] = float(round_cents(sum((Decimal(e['quantity']) * Decimal(str(e['unit_price'])) for e in kept), Decimal(0))))
53	    return answer, changes

62	        if len(encoded) > 65536:

65	        if len({p.get("position") for p in positions}) != len(positions):
66	            issues.append("duplicate position identifiers")

async def _until_collect_ends(ctx, coro) -> None:
    """Run `coro` until it ends or the collect time is used up. The cutoff follows the live submission reserve (it
    moves with the measured pace), so it is re-checked every second rather than fixed when the phase starts."""
    task = asyncio.ensure_future(coro)
    try:
        while not task.done():
            left = ctx.time_left()
            if left <= 0:
                task.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
                raise asyncio.TimeoutError
            await asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=min(1.0, max(0.05, left)))
        task.result()
    finally:
        if not task.done():
            task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)

INPUTS = ("brief", "tender", "quantities", "requirements", "materials", "erp", "discount", "mail")


def build_bid(ctx) -> dict:
    """compute() on what the board holds now, made schema-valid (malformed lines omitted, total recomputed)."""
    bid = compute({n: ctx.board.get(n) for n in INPUTS})
    from swarm.validation import answer_issues, prepare_answer
    original_positions = {p["position"] for p in bid["answer"]["positions"]}
    bid["answer"], repairs = prepare_answer(bid["answer"], ctx.task.get("answer_schema"))
    bid["issues"].extend(repairs)
    included = {p["position"] for p in bid["answer"]["positions"]}
    bid["omitted"] = sorted(set(bid["omitted"]) | (original_positions - included))
    bid["total_display"] = de_number(Decimal(str(bid["answer"]["total_net"])))
    bid["validation_errors"] = answer_issues(bid["answer"], ctx.task.get("answer_schema"))
    bid["issues"].extend(bid["validation_errors"])
    bid["coverage"]["priced"] = len(included)
    return bid


@register
class BidCalculator(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COMPUTE

    async def run(self) -> None:
        bid = build_bid(self.ctx)
        errors = bid["validation_errors"]
        if errors:
            self.ctx.board.error(self.name, "; ".join(errors))
        await self.ctx.board.set("bid", bid)
        await self.ctx.board.set("answer", None if errors else bid["answer"])
        self.log.info("bid: %s omitted=%s issues=%s", bid["answer"], bid["omitted"], bid["issues"])
        self.log.info("bid fields: %s", {l["position"]: {k: v for k, v in (l.get("fields") or {}).items()
                                                         if v != "verified"} for l in bid["lines"]})


DRAFT_EVERY_S = 3.0


@register
class BidDrafter(Agent):
    """The bid as it would be submitted now, recomputed during collection (plain code, no model): a usable partial
    bid exists as soon as one position is priced, and its open dependencies tell the collectors what is still missing
    for each position (results["bid_draft"]). Milestones mark the first usable bid and complete coverage."""
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    async def run(self) -> None:
        from swarm import timeline
        last = None
        while True:
            try:
                bid = build_bid(self.ctx)
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a half-collected board must never stop the drafts
                self.log.debug("draft failed: %s", error)
                await asyncio.sleep(DRAFT_EVERY_S)
                continue
            cov = bid["coverage"]
            signature = (json.dumps(bid["answer"], sort_keys=True), json.dumps(bid["unresolved"], sort_keys=True))
            if signature != last:
                last = signature
                await self.ctx.board.set("bid_draft", bid)
                self.log.info("draft: %d/%d positions priced, %d complete, total %s; open: %s", cov["priced"],
                              cov["positions"], cov["complete"], bid["total_display"],
                              {p: ids for p, ids in bid["unresolved"].items()})
                if cov["priced"]:
                    timeline.mark("first usable bid", positions=cov["priced"])
                if cov["positions"] and cov["priced"] == cov["positions"]:
                    timeline.mark("all positions priced")
                if cov["positions"] and cov["complete"] == cov["positions"]:
                    timeline.mark("all positions complete")
                for pos in cov.get("complete_positions") or []:
                    timeline.mark(f"position {pos} complete")
            await asyncio.sleep(DRAFT_EVERY_S)

        info = merge_materials(list(self.ctx.shared.get("erp.extracted", {}).values())).get(norm_ref(material)) or {}
        return info.get("is_active") is False

    # ---- jobs -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    async def extract_job(self, out: dict) -> dict:
        evidence = []
        for record in out.get("records") or []:
            data = record.get("data") or {}
            text = data.get("text") or data.get("_observed_text")
            if text:
                evidence.append(Evidence("erp.page", self.site_id,
                    {**data, "text": text, "url": data.get("url") or record.get("source"),
                     "topic": data.get("topic") or record.get("kind", "")}))
        return await extract_erp(self.ctx, evidence=evidence)

    def spawn(self, coro) -> None:
        """Background work that may queue jobs: counted as pending so no worker quits while it runs."""
        self.pending += 1
        task = asyncio.ensure_future(coro)
        self.background.add(task)
        self.ctx.shared.setdefault("background", set()).add(task)

        def finished(t):
            self.pending -= 1
            self.background.discard(t)
            if not t.cancelled() and t.exception() is not None:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"extraction: {type(t.exception()).__name__}: {t.exception()}")
        task.add_done_callback(finished)

    async def after_search(self, item: dict, out: dict) -> None:
        found = search_candidates(await self.extract_job(out), item)
        self.log.info("search %s: candidates %s", item["group"], found)
        for i, material in enumerate(found):
            self.rank.setdefault(norm_ref(material), i)
            self.add(("record", material, item))

    async def after_material(self, kind: str, material: str, item: dict, out: dict) -> None:
        await self.extract_job(out)
        from agents import analyze_materials
        await analyze_materials.publish(self.ctx)            # the match (and so the priorities) follows at once
        if kind == "record" and not self.blocked(material):
            self.add(("prices", material, item))
            self.add(("stock", material, item))
        self.focus(kind, material, item)

    def missing_for(self, kind: str, material: str) -> str:
        """What the bid calculation still misses from this material's `kind` pages ('' if nothing / not matched)."""
        from agents.compute_bid import build_bid
        try:
            bid = build_bid(self.ctx)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.log.debug("draft for focus failed: %s", error)
            return ""
        dep = (bid.get("dependencies") or {}).get(f"erp {kind} {norm_ref(material)}")
        return dep["need"] if dep else ""

    def focus(self, kind: str, material: str, item: dict) -> None:
        """One focused re-read when the calculation still misses something this kind of page should show."""
        if norm_ref(material) not in self.matched() or self.blocked(material):
            return
        missing = self.missing_for(kind, material)
        key = (kind, norm_ref(material))
        if missing and self.focused.get(key, 0) < MAX_FOCUSED:
            self.focused[key] = self.focused.get(key, 0) + 1
            self.log.info("%s %s still misses: %s -> focused re-read", kind, material, missing[:160])
            timeline.count("erp.focused")
            self.add((kind, material, item, missing), force=True)

    async def do(self, job: tuple, tab: Tab | None) -> None:
        extra = ANALYSIS_TIME_S
        if job[0] == "search":
            item = job[1]
            out = await self.browse_until_done(search_goal(item), attempts=2, tab=tab, max_steps=14, stop_extra=extra)
            self.spawn(self.after_search(item, out))
            return
        kind, material, item = job[:3]
        missing = job[3] if len(job) > 3 else ""
        if kind != "record" and self.blocked(material):
            self.log.info("%s %s skipped: material blocked", kind, material)
            return
        out = await self.browse_until_done(material_goal(kind, material, item, missing), attempts=2, tab=tab,
                                           max_steps=16, stop_extra=extra)
        self.spawn(self.after_material(kind, material, item, out))

    async def worker(self, tab: Tab | None) -> None:
        """Takes jobs until none is queued and no running job or extraction can add more (or time is up)."""
        try:
            while self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
                job = self.take()
                if job is None:
                    if self.pending <= 0 and self.producer_done:
                        return
                    await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                    continue
                label = f"{job[0]} {job[1] if job[0] != 'search' else job[1]['group']}"
                try:
                    with timeline.span("erp.job", label):
                        await self.do(job, tab)
                except Exception as error:
                    self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{label}: {error}")
                finally:
                    self.pending -= 1
        finally:
            if tab is not None:
                await tab.close()

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse_until_done("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, open "
                                             "material search help of material display transaction. Do NOT search "
                                             "yet. done once search form open.", attempts=1, max_steps=12)

            async def produce():
                try:
                    while self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
                        for item in await _items(self.ctx):
                            self.add(("search", item))
                        if self.ctx.board.get("requirements_final"):
                            return
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)
                finally:
                    self.producer_done = True
            async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
                group.create_task(produce())
                group.create_task(self.worker(None))
                for _ in range(ERP_TABS - 1):
                    group.create_task(self.worker(Tab(self.browser)))
            if self.background:                       # the last extractions (time is up for new jobs)
                await asyncio.wait(set(self.background), timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

def start_once(ctx, registry: str, key, factory) -> asyncio.Task:
    """The extraction task for `key`: the running one, or a new one (also when an earlier one ended without a
    result, so failed extractions retry). Tasks run on their own: a caller that stops waiting (cancelled, or only
    kicking new pages off) never cancels them, and a new page never waits for a slow sibling's batch. The
    orchestrator cancels what is still running when collection ends."""
    flight = ctx.shared.setdefault(f"{registry}.inflight", {})
    task = flight.get(key)
    if task is None or task.done():
        task = asyncio.ensure_future(factory())
        flight[key] = task
        ctx.shared.setdefault("background", set()).add(task)
    return task


async def settle(tasks) -> None:
    """Wait for `tasks` without cancelling them if this caller is cancelled."""
    tasks = [t for t in tasks if not t.done()]
    if tasks:
        await asyncio.wait(tasks)

class CheckParams(BaseModel):

def expected_values(bid: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """What the portal's summary should show, per position (material, quantity, unit price) and for the bid."""
    answer = bid.get("answer") or {}
    out: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    lines = {l["position"]: l for l in bid.get("lines") or []}
    for e in answer.get("positions") or []:
        disp = (lines.get(e["position"]) or {}).get("display") or {}
        out[e["position"]] = [str(e["material_number"]), str(e["quantity"]),
                              disp.get("unit_price") or de_number(Decimal(str(e["unit_price"])))]
    if answer.get("positions"):
        out["total"] = [bid.get("total_display") or de_number(Decimal(str(answer.get("total_net") or 0)))]
    return out


def check_page(text: str, expected: dict[str, list[str]]) -> list[str]:
    """Expected values not found on the page (numbers compared without spaces; case-insensitive)."""
    flat = norm_ref(text)
    return [f"{where}: {value}" for where, values in expected.items() for value in values
            if value and norm_ref(value) not in flat]

        """Log the mail browser's main tab in and open the inbox while the wizard is filled, so the TAN lookup later

@register
class WizardPrep(Agent):
    """Near the end of collection (PREP_LEAD_S before cutoff, or once every site's first pass is done), the tender
    portal's main tab logs in, opens the tender and its bid wizard and stops at the first step without entering
    anything. The submitter then starts in the wizard (ctx.shared["wizard_ready"] shortens the submission reserve)."""
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    background = True
    browser = 0

    async def run(self) -> None:
        ctx = self.ctx
        while ctx.time_left() > PREP_LEAD_S and not all(ctx.board.get(f"done.{r}") is not None
                                                        for r in ("tender", "spec", "erp", "mail")):
            await asyncio.sleep(2)
        if ctx.task.get("submission", {}).get("kind") == "api" or ctx.time_left() < 45:
            return
        site_id = await site_for(ctx, "tender")
        site = ctx.site(site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        reference = (ctx.board.get("brief") or {}).get("tender_reference")
        async with ctx.lock("main_tab.0"):
            with timeline.span("submit.prep", "wizard"):
                out = await browse(
                    ctx, f"Site (tender portal): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password "
                         f"{creds.get('password')!r}\n\nYOUR JOB: prepare the bid submission for tender {reference}: "
                         "log in if needed, accept necessary cookies, open the tender, register interest if the portal "
                         "requires it, open its bid submission (Angebotsabgabe) wizard and stop at its FIRST step. Do "
                         "NOT fill in, select, tick or submit anything in the wizard. done describing the wizard's "
                         "steps/sections as shown.", browser=0, site_id=site_id, max_steps=8, author=self.name,
                    stop_extra=0, careful=True)
        if out.get("done"):
            ctx.shared["wizard_ready"] = out.get("summary") or "wizard open"
            timeline.mark("wizard ready", left=round(ctx.seconds_left()))
        self.log.info("wizard prep done=%s: %s", out.get("done"), str(out.get("summary"))[:200])

"""Run a tests/ directory without pytest: unittest test cases plus plain pytest-style `test_*` functions.

scripts/team.py uses it when pytest is not installed, so a venv synced without the dev group does not make every
trial merge look red. Exit code 0 only if at least one test ran and none failed.

    python scripts/run_tests.py [tests]
"""
import importlib.util
import inspect
import sys
import traceback
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


def main(folder: str = "tests") -> int:
    root = Path(folder).resolve()
    sys.path[:0] = [str(root.parent), str(root)]
    suite, plain = unittest.TestSuite(), []
    for path in sorted(root.glob("test_*.py")):
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(path.stem, path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        try:
            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - an import error is a failed test file
            traceback.print_exc()
            return 1
        suite.addTests(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module))
        plain += [(path.stem, name, fn) for name, fn in vars(module).items()
                  if name.startswith("test_") and inspect.isfunction(fn) and not inspect.signature(fn).parameters]
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=0).run(suite)
    failed = len(result.failures) + len(result.errors)
    for module, name, fn in plain:
        try:
            fn()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            failed += 1
            print(f"FAIL {module}.{name}")
            traceback.print_exc()
    ran = result.testsRun + len(plain)
    print(f"{ran} tests, {failed} failed")
    return 0 if ran and not failed else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(*sys.argv[1:]))

"""Recovery that preserves work: a hung-tab check never closes another agent's active tab (real Chromium), a hung
tab of the caller is renewed in place, and a browse that crashes resumes with what is already saved."""
import asyncio
import http.server
import json
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.request
from unittest import mock

from swarm import browser_agent as ba
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard, Evidence
from swarm.context import Context
from tests.test_hung_tabs import Handler, free_port


class HungTabsOfOthers(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_own_unowned_and_idle_tabs_are_closed(self):
        from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

        server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        base, port = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}", free_port()

        async def run():
            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=[f"--remote-debugging-port={port}"])
                context = await browser.new_context()
                pages = [await context.new_page() for _ in range(3)]
                for page in pages:
                    await page.goto(base + "/")
                listed = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/json/list", timeout=5))
                ids = {t["url"] + str(i): t["id"] for i, t in enumerate(t for t in listed if t["type"] == "page")}
                targets = [t["id"] for t in listed if t["type"] == "page" and t["url"].startswith(base)]
                for page in pages:                     # every page hangs (a request that never answers)
                    await page.evaluate(f"setTimeout(() => location.href = '{base}/?block', 10)")
                await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
                other, mine, idle = ba.Tab(0), ba.Tab(0), ba.Tab(0)
                other.claim(targets[0])
                mine.claim(targets[1])
                idle.claim(targets[2])
                ba._ACTIVE.update({other, mine})       # `other` is another agent's tab with a browse running
                try:
                    with mock.patch.object(ba.browsers, "cdp_urls", return_value=[f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"]), \
                            mock.patch.object(ba, "TAB_PROBE_S", 3):
                        closed = await ba.close_hung_tabs(0, mine=mine)
                finally:
                    ba._ACTIVE.difference_update({other, mine})
                    for t in (other, mine, idle):
                        ba._OWNERS.pop(t.target_id, None)
                await browser.close()
                return closed, targets, ids

        closed, targets, _ = asyncio.run(run())
        server.shutdown()
        self.assertNotIn(targets[0], closed)          # another agent's active tab: never touched
        self.assertIn(targets[1], closed)             # the caller's own hung tab
        self.assertIn(targets[2], closed)             # an owned tab nobody is browsing in


class RenewInPlace(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_hung_own_tab_is_renewed_and_main_tab_stays_main(self):
        tab = ba.main_tab(3)
        tab.claim("dead-target")
        tab.suspect = True

        async def responds(browser, timeout=12):
            return True

        async def hung(browser, keep=None, mine=None):
            return ["dead-target"]
        with mock.patch.object(ba.browsers, "cdp_urls", return_value=["http://127.0.0.1:1"]), \
                mock.patch.object(ba, "browser_responds", responds), mock.patch.object(ba, "close_hung_tabs", hung):
            again = asyncio.run(ba.responsive_tab(tab))
        self.assertIs(again, tab)
        self.assertIs(ba.main_tab(3), tab)
        self.assertTrue(tab.renewed and tab.target_id is None and not tab.used)
        self.assertNotIn("dead-target", ba._OWNERS)
        ba._MAIN_TABS.pop(3, None)

    def test_healthy_recently_checked_browser_is_not_probed_again(self):
        calls = []

        async def responds(browser, timeout=12):
            calls.append(browser)
            return True

        async def none(browser, keep=None, mine=None):
            return []
        with mock.patch.object(ba.browsers, "cdp_urls", return_value=["http://127.0.0.1:1"]), \
                mock.patch.object(ba, "browser_responds", responds), mock.patch.object(ba, "close_hung_tabs", none):
            ba._CHECKED.pop(0, None)
            asyncio.run(ba.responsive_tab(ba.Tab(0)))
            asyncio.run(ba.responsive_tab(ba.Tab(0)))
            suspect = ba.Tab(0)
            suspect.suspect = True
            asyncio.run(ba.responsive_tab(suspect))
        self.assertEqual(calls, [0, 0])               # second healthy check skipped; a suspect tab is checked
        ba._CHECKED.pop(0, None)


class CrashResume(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_crashed_browse_is_retried_with_what_is_saved(self):
        from swarm import scraper as sc

        class Fixture(sc.SiteScraper):
            role, browser, site_id = "spec", 1, "s"

            def goal(self):
                return "collect"
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "", "access": [{"siteId": "s", "url": "https://s.example", "credentials": {}}]},
                      board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        jobs = []

        async def fake_browse(ctx_, prompt, **kwargs):
            jobs.append(prompt)
            if len(jobs) == 1:
                await kwargs["on_record"]({"kind": "page", "data": {"topic": "spec revisions", "text": "x"},
                                           "source": "u", "note": ""})
                raise RuntimeError("CDP connection lost")
            return {"summary": "requirements saved", "done": True, "records": [], "steps": 3}
        with mock.patch.object(sc, "browse", fake_browse):
            out = await Fixture(ctx).browse_until_done("read the requirement table", attempts=3)
        self.assertTrue(out["done"])
        self.assertEqual(len(jobs), 2)
        self.assertIn("Already saved: ['spec revisions']", jobs[1])      # resumes; does not start over
        self.assertEqual(len(ctx.board.query("spec.page")), 1)            # the first attempt's page survived

    unittest.main()

"""What the bid needs, and how evidence turns into it. Invented values only.

- every omitted position / estimated field names its open dependency, and gap detection sees it (missing price unit)
- price condition fragments merge only when they belong together; conflicts and unrelated records stay apart
- delivery commitments, packaging, bonus: verified vs. justified absence vs. estimated
- ERP scheduling finishes positions first and never waits for extraction; draft bid; live submission reserve
"""
import asyncio
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from agents.analyze_materials import erp_view, reconcile_conditions
from agents.compute_bid import compute
from swarm import timeline
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.context import Context


def inputs(**over) -> dict:
    base = {
        "brief": {"tender_reference": "T-1", "scenario_date": "2031-02-01T09:00:00Z"},
        "tender": {"positions": [{"position": "1", "unit": "Stk", "requirement_ref": "Z"}],
                   "clarifications": [{"number": "1", "date": "2031-01-01", "positions": ["1"], "keys": {}}]},
        "quantities": {"1": {"quantity": 10}}, "requirements": {"Z": {}},
        "materials": {"1": {"material": "M1"}},
        "erp": {"materials": {"M1": {"lead_time_stock_weeks": "1", "lead_time_production_weeks": "6",
                                     "surcharge_mass_g": "0"}},
                "conditions": [{"material": "M1", "valid_from": "2031-01-01", "valid_to": "2031-12-31",
                                "price_unit": "1", "scales": [{"min_qty": "1", "price": "100"}]}],
                "stock": {"M1": {"free": "50"}}},
        "discount": {"percent": "0", "source": "no valid approval found"}, "mail": {},
    }
    base.update(over)
    return base


class Dependencies(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_price_unit_names_its_dependency_and_is_a_gap(self):
        data = inputs()
        del data["erp"]["conditions"][0]["price_unit"]
        bid = compute(data)
        self.assertEqual(bid["answer"]["positions"], [])
        self.assertEqual(bid["unresolved"], {"1": ["erp prices M1"]})
        self.assertIn("price unit", bid["dependencies"]["erp prices M1"]["need"])
        # the coordinator's checks saw a valid condition with scales and reported nothing before
        from agents.coordinate import find_gaps
        board = Blackboard()
        board.results.update(data)
        gaps = {g["id"]: g for g in find_gaps(board, {"tender", "spec", "erp", "mail"}, {"tender": ["bidder q&a"]})}
        self.assertIn("price unit", gaps["erp prices M1"]["need"])

    def test_complete_position_has_no_open_dependency(self):
        bid = compute(inputs())
        self.assertEqual(bid["coverage"]["complete"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(bid["unresolved"], {})
        fields = bid["lines"][0]["fields"]
        self.assertEqual(fields["base"], "verified")
        self.assertEqual(fields["packaging"], "absent")          # the Q&A gives the position no packaging key
        self.assertEqual(fields["lead"], "verified: stock")

    def test_missing_delivery_commitment_is_an_estimate_with_its_dependency(self):
        data = inputs()
        data["tender"]["clarifications"][0]["keys"] = {"delivery_key": "D-1"}
        bid = compute(data)
        line = bid["lines"][0]
        self.assertTrue(line["fields"]["lead"].startswith("estimated"))
        self.assertIn("mail delivery_commitments D-1", line["unresolved"])
        data["mail"] = {"delivery_commitments": {"D-1": {"material": "OTHER", "weeks": "2", "max_total_pieces": "99"}}}
        line = compute(data)["lines"][0]                          # a commitment for another material does not apply
        self.assertEqual(line["fields"]["lead"], "verified: stock (commitment is for another material)")
        self.assertEqual(line["unresolved"], [])
        data["mail"]["delivery_commitments"]["D-1"]["material"] = "M1"
        self.assertEqual(compute(data)["answer"]["positions"][0]["lead_time_weeks"], 2)

    def test_bonus_and_packaging_without_their_mails_are_open_not_zero(self):
        data = inputs()
        data["tender"]["clarifications"][0]["keys"] = {"bonus_plan": "B", "packaging_tariff": "P"}
        data["erp"]["materials"]["M1"]["pieces_per_carton"] = "4"
        bid = compute(data)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(bid["unresolved"]["1"]), ["mail packaging_tariffs P", "mail project_bonus B"])
        self.assertNotIn("rebate_total", bid["answer"]["positions"][0])
        self.assertTrue(bid["lines"][0]["fields"]["bonus"].startswith("estimated"))


class ConditionEvidence(unittest.TestCase):
    SCALES = [{"min_qty": "1", "price": "200"}, {"min_qty": "10", "price": "150"}]

    def price(self, conditions, pieces=10):
        data = inputs()
        data["erp"]["conditions"] = conditions
        bid = compute(data)
        return (bid["answer"]["positions"][0]["base_unit_price"] if bid["answer"]["positions"] else None), bid

    def test_fragment_of_another_record_does_not_complete_the_valid_one(self):
        header = {"material": "M1", "record": "C-1", "valid_from": "2031-01-01", "valid_to": "2031-12-31",
                  "price_unit": "1", "scales": []}
        foreign = {"material": "M1", "record": "C-9", "scales": self.SCALES}
        merged = reconcile_conditions([header, foreign])
        self.assertEqual(len(merged), 2)
        price, bid = self.price([header, foreign])
        self.assertIsNone(price)
        self.assertIn("quantity scales of the valid price condition (record C-1)",
                      bid["dependencies"]["erp prices M1"]["need"])

    def test_record_id_picks_the_right_one_of_several_periods(self):
        old = {"material": "M1", "record": "C-1", "valid_from": "2030-01-01", "valid_to": "2030-12-31",
               "price_unit": "1", "scales": []}
        new = {"material": "M1", "record": "C-2", "valid_from": "2031-01-01", "valid_to": "2031-12-31",
               "price_unit": "1", "scales": []}
        scales_of_old = {"material": "M1", "record": "C-1", "scales": self.SCALES}
        price, bid = self.price([old, new, scales_of_old])
        self.assertIsNone(price)                     # the expired record's scales never price the valid one
        scales_of_new = {"material": "M1", "record": "C-2", "scales": [{"min_qty": "1", "price": "120"}]}
        price, _ = self.price([old, new, scales_of_old, scales_of_new])
        self.assertEqual(price, 120.0)

    def test_two_reads_that_disagree_are_a_conflict_not_a_choice(self):
        a = {"material": "M1", "record": "C-1", "valid_from": "2031-01-01", "valid_to": "2031-12-31",
             "price_unit": "1", "scales": self.SCALES}

                  "scales": []}

class ErpScheduling(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def scraper(self):
        from agents.scrape_erp import ErpScraper
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "", "access": []}, board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        ctx.board.results["tender"] = {"positions": [{"position": "1", "requirement_ref": "A"},
                                                     {"position": "2", "requirement_ref": "B"}]}
        ctx.board.results["materials"] = {"1": {"material": "M1", "unverified": []}, "2": {"material": None}}
        return ErpScraper(ctx)

    async def test_finishing_a_matched_position_comes_first_and_covered_records_last(self):
        erp = self.scraper()
        item_a = {"group": "GA", "requirements": [{"ref": "A"}]}
        item_b = {"group": "GB", "requirements": [{"ref": "B"}]}
        erp.rank.update({"M5": 1, "M7": 0, "M8": 1})
        for job in [("record", "M5", item_a), ("search", item_b), ("record", "M8", item_b), ("record", "M7", item_b),
                    ("prices", "M9", item_b), ("prices", "M1", item_a), ("stock", "M1", item_a),
                    ("prices", "M1", item_a, "price unit of the valid condition")]:
            erp.add(job, force=len(job) > 3)
        order = []
        while (job := erp.take()) is not None:
            order.append(job[0] + " " + (job[1] if job[0] != "search" else job[1]["group"]) + (" focus" if len(job) > 3 else ""))
        self.assertEqual(order, ["prices M1 focus", "prices M1", "stock M1", "search GB", "record M7", "record M8",
                                 "prices M9", "record M5"])

    async def test_worker_takes_the_next_job_while_extraction_runs(self):
        erp = self.scraper()
        erp.site_id = "erp"
        browsed, release = [], asyncio.Event()

        async def fake_browse_until_done(goal, **kwargs):
            browsed.append(goal)
            return {"records": [], "done": True}

        async def slow_extract(out):
            await release.wait()
            return {}
        erp.browse_until_done = fake_browse_until_done
        erp.extract_job = slow_extract
        item = {"group": "GB", "requirements": [{"ref": "B"}]}
        erp.add(("search", item))
        erp.add(("record", "M7", item))
        erp.producer_done = True
        with mock.patch("agents.scrape_erp.search_candidates", return_value=[]):
            worker = asyncio.create_task(erp.worker(None))
            for _ in range(50):
                await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
                if len(browsed) == 2:
                    break
            self.assertEqual(len(browsed), 2)        # the record browse ran before the search was extracted
            self.assertFalse(worker.done())          # pending extraction keeps the worker alive
            release.set()
            await asyncio.wait_for(worker, 3)

        from agents.compute_bid import BidDrafter
        tl = timeline.reset()
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "", "access": []}, board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        ctx.board.results.update(inputs())
        task = asyncio.create_task(BidDrafter(ctx).run())

        task.cancel()

        self.assertIn("first usable bid", tl.milestones)
        self.assertIn("all positions complete", tl.milestones)

    def test_reserve_follows_positions_pace_and_wizard_prep(self):
        from swarm import context as c
        tl = timeline.reset()
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "", "access": []}, board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        ctx.board.results["tender"] = {"positions": [{"position": str(i)} for i in range(5)]}
        with mock.patch.object(c, "FIXED_RESERVE", False):
            for i in range(10):
                tl.add("browse.step", "step", i * 10.0, i * 10.0 + 10.0)        # 10 s per step measured
            slow_free = ctx.submit_reserve()
            ctx.shared["wizard_ready"] = "wizard open"
            prepared = ctx.submit_reserve()
            for i in range(40):
                tl.add("browse.step", "step", 0.0, 40.0)                        # pace drops to 40 s per step
            slow = ctx.submit_reserve()
        self.assertLess(prepared, slow_free)
        self.assertLessEqual(c.MIN_RESERVE_S, prepared)
        self.assertEqual(slow, c.MAX_RESERVE_S)

    async def test_collection_cutoff_follows_the_live_reserve(self):
        from swarm.orchestrator import _until_collect_ends
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "", "access": []}, board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        left = [3.0]
        ctx.time_left = lambda: left[0]
        stopped = asyncio.Event()

        async def work():
            try:
                await asyncio.sleep(60)
            finally:
                stopped.set()
        runner = asyncio.create_task(_until_collect_ends(ctx, work()))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        left[0] = 0                                  # the reserve grew: collection must end now
        with self.assertRaises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
            await asyncio.wait_for(runner, 3)
        self.assertTrue(stopped.is_set())

"""Turn a saved run log (.swarm/runs/<run>-log.md) into a timeline: where the time went, per agent.

Works on logs of any version: it reads the swarm's own lines (phases, browse steps, analyst results, submission) and,
when present, the runtime timeline's `milestone` / `progress` / `TIMELINE` lines (swarm/timeline.py).

    uv run --no-sync python scripts/timeline.py .swarm/runs/run_xxx-log.md [--gap 30]

Reports (run clock = seconds since the COLLECT phase started):
- milestones: brief, site roles, first page per site, first requirements, first ERP candidates, materials matched,
  each phase, submission attempts, accepted submission (plus the runtime's own milestones)
- per agent: steps, first/last step, busy time, idle gaps longer than --gap seconds (waiting or stalled)
- trouble: state timeouts, empty model replies, crashed browses, cleanup overruns, model timeouts, failed extractions
The log holds scenario values: read the output, never copy values from it into the package.
"""
import argparse
import re
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

LINE = re.compile(r"^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}),(\d{3}) (\S+) (.*)$")
STEP = re.compile(r"^(\S+) step (\d+): (.*)$")
TROUBLE = {"state timeouts": "repeated browser-state timeouts", "no model reply": "step \\d+: no reply",
           "crashed browses": "browser agent failed|swarm \\w+ failed", "cleanup overruns": "cleanup exceeded",
           "model timeouts": "LLM call timed out|model TimeoutError", "failed extractions": "extract chunk failed",
           "hung tabs closed": "closed a hung tab", "browser moved": "is unreachable"}
MILESTONES = [("brief read", r"BriefReader brief facts"), ("site roles", r"sites site roles"),
              ("first requirements", r"RequirementAnalyzer current revision \S+, requirements \[['\"]"),
              ("positions known", r"QuantityAnalyzer [1-9]\d* positions"),
              ("first ERP candidates", r"search \S+: candidates \[['\"]"),
              ("first draft bid", r"BidDrafter draft: [1-9]"), ("materials matched", r"MaterialMatcher materials:"),
              ("collect end", r"phase VERIFY"), ("submit start", r"phase SUBMIT"),
              ("submission attempt", r"submission attempt \d+ finished"),
              ("accepted", r"portal acceptance confirmed|milestone accepted submission")]


def parse(path: Path):
    events = []
    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        m = LINE.match(raw.strip())
        if m:
            ts = datetime.strptime(m.group(1), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").timestamp() + int(m.group(2)) / 1000
            events.append((ts, m.group(3), m.group(4)))
    events.sort(key=lambda e: e[0])
    return events


def clock(s: float) -> str:
    s = max(0, int(s))
    return f"{s // 60:02d}:{s % 60:02d}"


def analyse(events, gap: float) -> str:
    if not events:
        return "no timestamped lines"
    start = next((ts for ts, logger, msg in events if logger == "swarm" and "phase COLLECT" in msg), events[0][0])
    out = [f"run clock 00:00 = COLLECT start; log covers {clock(events[0][0] - start)}..{clock(events[-1][0] - start)} "
           "(the platform keeps only the tail of long logs: early lines may be missing)", "", "## Milestones"]
    seen = set()
    for ts, logger, msg in events:
        text = f"{logger} {msg}"
        for name, pattern in MILESTONES:
            if (name not in seen or name == "submission attempt") and re.search(pattern, text):
                seen.add(name)
                out.append(f"- {clock(ts - start)} {name}: {msg[:110]}")
        if logger == "timeline" and msg.startswith("milestone"):
            out.append(f"- (runtime) {msg[:140]}")
    steps = defaultdict(list)
    for ts, logger, msg in events:
        m = STEP.match(msg) if logger == "browse" else None
        if m:
            steps[m.group(1)].append(ts)
    out += ["", "## Browsing per agent", "| agent | steps | first | last | median step | idle gaps > %ds |" % gap,
            "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    for agent, times in sorted(steps.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0]):
        deltas = [b - a for a, b in zip(times, times[1:])]
        med = sorted(deltas)[len(deltas) // 2] if deltas else 0
        gaps = [f"{clock(a - start)} +{b - a:.0f}s" for a, b in zip(times, times[1:]) if b - a > gap]
        out.append(f"| {agent} | {len(times)} | {clock(times[0] - start)} | {clock(times[-1] - start)} | {med:.1f}s | "
                   f"{', '.join(gaps[:6]) + (' ...' if len(gaps) > 6 else '') or '-'} |")
    out += ["", "## Trouble"]
    for name, pattern in TROUBLE.items():
        hits = [ts for ts, logger, msg in events if re.search(pattern, f"{logger} {msg}")]
        if hits:
            out.append(f"- {name}: {len(hits)} (first {clock(hits[0] - start)})")
    runtime = [msg for _, logger, msg in events if logger == "timeline" and msg.startswith("TIMELINE")]
    progress = [f"{clock(ts - start)} {msg}" for ts, logger, msg in events if logger == "swarm" and msg.startswith("progress")]
    if progress:
        out += ["", "## Progress (runtime, per minute)"] + [f"- {p[:260]}" for p in progress]
    if runtime:
        out += ["", "## Runtime timeline report"] + [f"- {r[:600]}" for r in runtime]
    return "\n".join(out)


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("log", type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--gap", type=float, default=30.0)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    print(analyse(parse(args.log), args.gap))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

input.new_string:
## Time budget (20-minute run)

Collecting/analysing stops `ctx.submit_reserve()` seconds before expiry, then VERIFY/COMPUTE (instant) and SUBMIT,
which stops `FINAL_MARGIN_S` (40 s) before expiry. The reserve is estimated live: (wizard steps + 2.5 steps per
position, minus the steps WizardPrep already did) x measured median browsing step x 1.5 (full reasoning) + TAN lookup +
safety, clamped to [390, 600] s. `SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S` > 0 fixes it. The collect cutoff and every browse's stop mark
follow the live value (re-checked each second / before each step).

## Where the time goes (swarm/timeline.py, scripts/timeline.py)

Spans per agent: `browse.step`, `model.queue` (waiting for a slot), `model.call`, `extract`, `wait.dep` (an agent
waiting for an upstream result), `recovery` (browser checks, hung tabs, failed model attempts), `guard`, `browse.failed`;
counters for repeated work (`reads.repeat`, `browse.retries`, `erp.focused`, `browse.crashed`, ...); milestones (first
page per site, first requirements, first usable bid, each position complete, wizard ready, collect end, submit start,
TAN requested/received, entries checked, accepted submission). The run log gets a `progress` line per minute and five
`TIMELINE` lines at the end (the platform keeps only the log's tail); local runs also write `.swarm/timeline.json`.
`scripts/timeline.py <saved log>` rebuilds a timeline from any run log, old or new.

## Coordination (what no longer waits)

- `BidDrafter` recomputes the bid every 3 s during collection (`results["bid_draft"]`); the submitter falls back to it.
- `compute()` names an open dependency for every omitted position and estimated field (`dependencies`, `unresolved`,
  per-line `fields` status: verified / absent / estimated / missing). The coordinator turns those into gaps too, so a
  condition without a price unit is a gap, not "no gaps". Mail gaps start 30 s after the index pass was analysed; a site
  with follow-ups running takes new, different gaps (max 2 at once per site); an unchanged gap set is re-planned only
  after 45 s.
- ERP: the next job is chosen when a tab is free: focused re-reads of what the calculation misses, then prices/stock of
  materials that already match a position, then searches and the best candidate per requirement, then other
  candidates; candidates of already matched positions last. Extraction runs in the background (the tab moves on).
- Analysts extract each page in its own task (`swarm.extract.start_once`): a new page never waits for a slow batch.
- Price conditions: `reconcile_conditions` merges pages of one record only (same record id, linked page URLs, or a
  single dated condition); conflicting reads become `_conflict` (unpriced, a gap), unrelated fragments stay apart.

## Recovery

- A hung-tab check closes only the caller's tab, unowned tabs and idle owned tabs, never another agent's active tab;
  a healthy browser is not re-checked within 20 s. A hung own tab is renewed in place (main tabs stay main tabs).
- A crashed browse returns an unfinished result (its pages are already saved); `browse_until_done` retries with the
  saved topics instead of losing the scraper.
- Browsing model calls time out after 35 s (`SWARM_BROWSE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S`) instead of 55 s.

## Submission

`WizardPrep` opens the bid wizard in browser 0's main tab near the end of collection (entering nothing); at submit
start the mail main tab logs in and opens the inbox; `check_entries` compares the summary page with the bid in code.
